[No.279] Prefix-Tree Decoding for Predicting Mass Spectra from Molecules
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 基于前缀树解码的分子质量谱预测
类别: 
作者: Samuel Goldman;John Bradshaw;Jiayi Xin;Connor W. Coley;
机构: Massachusetts Institute of Technology;University of Hong Kong;
类型: Spotlight
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/71858
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.06470
英摘: Computational predictions of mass spectra from molecules have enabled the discovery of clinically relevant metabolites. However, such predictive tools are still limited as they occupy one of two extremes, either operating (a) by fragmenting molecules combinatorially with overly rigid constraints on potential rearrangements and poor time complexity or (b) by decoding lossy and nonphysical discretized spectra vectors. In this work, we use a new intermediate strategy for predicting mass spectra from molecules by treating mass spectra as sets of molecular formulae, which are themselves multisets of atoms. After first encoding an input molecular graph, we decode a set of molecular subformulae, each of which specify a predicted peak in the mass spectrum, the intensities of which are predicted by a second model. Our key insight is to overcome the combinatorial possibilities for molecular subformulae by decoding the formula set using a prefix tree structure, atom-type by atom-type, representing a general method for ordered multiset decoding. We show promising empirical results on mass spectra prediction tasks.
中摘: 从分子预测质量谱的能力使得临床相关代谢物的发现成为可能。然而，这样的预测工具仍然有限，因为它们要么通过以过于刚性的方式组合性地裂解分子并限制潜在重排的可能性，导致较差的时间复杂度（a）；要么通过解码失真且非物理的质量谱向量（b）。在本文中，我们采用了一种新的中间策略来预测分子的质量谱，即将质量谱视为分子公式的集合，而这些分子公式又是原子的多重集。首先对输入的分子图进行编码，然后解码一个分子子公式的集合，每个子公式指定质量谱中的一个预测峰，其强度由第二个模型预测。我们的关键洞察是，通过使用前缀树结构，按原子类型逐步解码公式集，从而克服分子子公式组合的可能性，这是一种有序多重集解码的一般方法。我们在质量谱预测任务上展示了有前景的实证结果。

英摘: We consider online prediction of a binary sequence with expert advice. [No.281] Online List Labeling with Predictions
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 在线列表标签预测
类别: 
作者: Samuel McCauley;Benjamin Moseley;Aidin Niaparast;Shikha Singh;
机构: Williams College;RelationalAI;
类型: Spotlight
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/69916
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.10536
英摘: A growing line of work shows how learned predictions can be used to break through worst-case barriers to improve the running time of an algorithm. However, incorporating predictions into data structures with strong theoretical guarantees remains underdeveloped. This paper takes a step in this direction by showing that predictions can be leveraged in the fundamental online list labeling problem. In the problem, n items arrive over time and must be stored in sorted order in an array of size Theta(n). The array slot of an element is its label and the goal is to maintain sorted order while minimizing the total number of elements moved (i.e., relabeled). We design a new list labeling data structure and bound its performance in two models. In the worst-case learning-augmented model, we give guarantees in terms of the error in the predictions. Our data structure provides strong guarantees: it is optimal for any prediction error and guarantees the best-known worst-case bound even when the predictions are entirely erroneous. We also consider a stochastic error model and bound the performance in terms of the expectation and variance of the error. Finally, the theoretical results are demonstrated empirically. In particular, we show that our data structure has strong performance on real temporal data sets where predictions are constructed from elements that arrived in the past, as is typically done in a practical use case.
中摘: 越来越多的研究表明，利用学习预测可以突破最坏情况下的障碍，从而改进算法的运行时间。然而，将预测整合到具有强大理论保证的数据结构中仍然是一个未充分开发的领域。本文在这方面迈出了一步，通过展示如何在基本的在线列表标记问题中利用预测来实现这一目标。在这个问题中，n个项目随着时间的推移陆续到达，并且必须以排序顺序存储在一个大小为Θ(n)的数组中。元素的数组槽位即为其标签，目标是在保持排序顺序的同时，尽量减少需要移动（即重新标记）的元素总数。我们设计了一个新的列表标记数据结构，并在其两种模型中对其性能进行了边界设定。在最坏情况下的学习增强模型中，我们根据预测误差提供了保证。我们的数据结构提供了强有力的保证：对于任何预测误差，它都是最优的，并且即使预测完全错误，也能保证已知的最佳最坏情况界。我们还考虑了随机误差模型，并根据误差的期望值和方差对其性能进行了边界设定。最后，理论结果通过实证研究得到了验证。特别是，我们展示了当预测基于过去到达的元素构建时，我们的数据结构在实际使用案例中具有强大的表现力。

[No.282] MEGABYTE: Predicting Million-byte Sequences with Multiscale Transformers
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: MEGABYTE：使用多尺度变换器预测百万字节序列
类别: 
作者: LILI YU;Daniel Simig;Colin Flaherty;Armen Aghajanyan;Luke Zettlemoyer;Mike Lewis;
机构: Meta;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/72057

英摘: Autoregressive transformers are spectacular models for short sequences but scale poorly to long sequences such as high-resolution images, podcasts, code, or books. We proposed Megabyte, a multi-scale decoder architecture that enables end-to-end differentiable modeling of sequences of over one million bytes. Megabyte segments sequences into patches and uses a local submodel within patches and a global model between patches. This enables sub-quadratic self-attention, much larger feedforward layers for the same compute, and improved parallelism during decoding -- unlocking better performance at reduced cost for both training and generation. Extensive experiments show that Megabyte allows byte-level models to perform competitively with subword models on long context language modeling, achieve state-of-the-art density estimation on ImageNet, and model audio from raw files. Together, these results establish the viability of tokenization-free autoregressive sequence modeling at scale.
中摘: 自回归变压器模型在处理短序列时表现优异，但在处理高分辨率图像、播客、代码或书籍等长序列时扩展性较差。我们提出了Megabyte，一种多尺度解码器架构，使其能够端到端地对超过一百万字节的序列进行可微分建模。Megabyte将序列分割成块，并在块内使用局部子模型，在块间使用全局模型。这使得其能够实现次二次时间复杂度的自注意力机制，同时在相同计算资源下拥有更大的前馈层，并在解码过程中提高并行性——从而在训练和生成阶段以更低的成本获得更好的性能。大量实验表明，Megabyte使字节级模型能够在长上下文语言建模任务上与子词级模型竞争，实现ImageNet上的最佳密度估计，并直接从原始文件建模音频。这些结果共同证明了在大规模情况下无标记化自回归序列建模的可行性。

[No.283] Estimating and Controlling for Equalized Odds via Sensitive Attribute Predictors
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 通过敏感属性预测器估计和控制平等机会
类别: 
作者: Beepul Bharti;Paul Yi;Jeremias Sulam;
机构: Johns Hopkins University;University of Maryland;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/70984
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.12497
英摘: As the use of machine learning models in real world high-stakes decision settings continues to grow, it is highly important that we are able to audit and control for any potential fairness violations these models may exhibit towards certain groups. To do so, one naturally requires access to sensitive attributes, such as demographics, gender, or other potentially sensitive features that determine group membership. Unfortunately, in many settings, this information is often unavailable. In this work we study the well known \emph{equalized odds} (EOD) definition of fairness. In a setting without sensitive attributes, we first provide tight and computable upper bounds for the EOD violation of a predictor. These bounds precisely reflect the worst possible EOD violation. Second, we demonstrate how one can provably control the worst-case EOD by a new post-processing correction method. Our results characterize when directly controlling for EOD with respect to the predicted sensitive attributes is -- and when is not -- optimal when it comes to controlling worst-case EOD. Our results hold under assumptions that are milder than previous works, and we illustrate these results with experiments on synthetic and real datasets.

[No.285] Dynamics of Finite Width Kernel and Prediction Fluctuations in Mean Field Neural Networks
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 有限宽度核的动力学与均场神经网络中的预测波动
类别: 
作者: Blake Bordelon;Cengiz Pehlevan;
机构: Harvard University;
类型: Spotlight
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/70910
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.03408
英摘: We analyze the dynamics of finite width effects in wide but finite feature learning neural networks. Starting from a dynamical mean field theory description of infinite width deep neural network kernel and prediction dynamics, we provide a characterization of the $O(1/\sqrt{\text{width}})$ fluctuations of the DMFT order parameters over random initializations of the network weights. Our results, while perturbative in width, unlike prior analyses, are non-perturbative in the strength of feature learning. In the lazy limit of network training, all kernels are random but static in time and the prediction variance has a universal form. However, in the rich, feature learning regime, the fluctuations of the kernels and predictions are dynamically coupled with a variance that can be computed self-consistently. In two layer networks, we show how feature learning can dynamically reduce the variance of the final tangent kernel and final network predictions. We also show how initialization variance can slow down online learning in wide but finite networks. In deeper networks, kernel variance can dramatically accumulate through subsequent layers at large feature learning strengths, but feature learning continues to improve the signal-to-noise ratio of the feature kernels. In discrete time, we demonstrate that large learning rate phenomena such as edge of stability effects can be well captured by infinite width dynamics and that initialization variance can decrease dynamically. For CNNs trained on CIFAR-10, we empirically find significant corrections to both the bias and variance of network dynamics due to finite width.

英摘: Learning binary classifiers from positive and unlabeled data (PUL) is vital in many real-world applications, especially when verifying negative examples is difficult. In this paper, we unveil an intriguing yet long-overlooked observation in PUL: \textit{resampling the positive data in each training iteration to ensure a balanced distribution between positive and unlabeled examples results in strong early-stage performance. Furthermore, predictive trends for positive and negative classes display distinctly different patterns.} Specifically, the scores (output probability) of unlabeled negative examples consistently decrease, while those of unlabeled positive examples show largely chaotic trends. Notably, our method accomplishes PUL without requiring additional parameter tuning or prior assumptions, offering an alternative perspective for tackling this problem. Extensive experiments verify the superiority of our method, particularly in a highly imbalanced real-world setting, where it achieves improvements of up to $11.3\%$ in key metrics. 英摘: We investigate the problem of machine learning-based (ML) predictive inference on individual treatment effects (ITEs). In this paper, we develop conformal meta-learners, a general framework for issuing predictive intervals for ITEs by applying the standard conformal prediction (CP) procedure on top of CATE meta-learners. Whereas existing procedures conduct inference on nuisance parameters (i.e., potential outcomes) via weighted CP, conformal meta-learners enable direct inference on the target parameter (ITE). Numerical experiments show that conformal meta-learners provide valid intervals with competitive efficiency while retaining the favorable point estimation properties of CATE meta-learners.

英摘: The problem of piecewise affine (PWA) regression and planning is of foundational importance to the study of online learning, control, and robotics, where it provides a theoretically and empirically tractable setting to study systems undergoing sharp changes in the dynamics. Unfortunately, due to the discontinuities that arise when crossing into different ``pieces,'' learning in general sequential settings is impossible and practical algorithms are forced to resort to heuristic approaches. This paper builds on the recently developed smoothed online learning framework and provides the first algorithms for prediction and simulation in PWA systems whose regret is polynomial in all relevant problem parameters under a weak smoothness assumption; moreover, our algorithms are efficient in the number of calls to an optimization oracle. We further apply our results to the problems of one-step prediction and multi-step simulation regret in piecewise affine dynamical systems, where the learner is tasked with simulating trajectories and regret is measured in terms of the Wasserstein distance between simulated and true data. Along the way, we develop several technical tools of more general interest.

[No.294] Swap Agnostic Learning, or Characterizing Omniprediction via Multicalibration
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 换序无影响学习，或通过多校准表征无所不能的预测
类别: 
作者: Parikshit Gopalan;Michael P. Kim;Omer Reingold;
机构: Apple;Stanford University;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/72084
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.06726
英摘: We introduce and study Swap Agnostic Learning. The problem can be phrased as a game between a predictor and an adversary: first, the predictor selects a hypothesis $h$; then, the adversary plays in response, and for each level set of the predictor $\{x \in \mathcal{X} : h(x) = v\}$ selects a (different) loss-minimizing hypothesis $c_v \in \mathcal{C}$; the predictor wins if $h$ competes with the adaptive adversary's loss. Despite the strength of the adversary, we demonstrate the feasibility Swap Agnostic Learning for any convex loss.
  Somewhat surprisingly, the result follows through an investigation into the connections between Omniprediction and Multicalibration. Omniprediction is a new notion of optimality for predictors that strengthtens classical notions such as agnostic learning. It asks for loss minimization guarantees (relative to a hypothesis class) that apply not just for a specific loss function, but for any loss belonging to a rich family of losses. A recent line of work shows that omniprediction is implied by multicalibration and related multi-group fairness notions. This unexpected connection raises the question: is multi-group fairness necessary for omniprediction?
  Our work gives the first affirmative answer to this question. We establish an equivalence between swap variants of omniprediction and multicalibration and swap agnostic learning. Further, swap multicalibration is essentially equivalent to the standard notion of multicalibration, so existing learning algorithms can be used to achieve any of the three notions. Building on this characterization, we paint a complete picture of the relationship between different variants of multi-group fairness, omniprediction, and Outcome Indistinguishability. This inquiry reveals a unified notion of OI that captures all existing notions of omniprediction and multicalibration.
中摘: 我们介绍了并研究了Swap Agnostic Learning。这个问题可以表述为预测器与对手之间的博弈：首先，预测器选择一个假设$h$；然后，对手作出回应，并从预测器每个水平集$\{x \in \mathcal{X} : h(x) = v\}$中选择一个不同的损失最小化假设$c_v \in \mathcal{C}$；预测器获胜的条件是$h$能够与适应性对手的损失进行竞争。尽管对手非常强大，我们证明了对于任何凸损失函数，Swap Agnostic Learning都是可行的。

令人惊讶的是，这一结果通过探讨Omniprediction和Multicalibration之间的联系而得出。Omniprediction是一种新的预测器最优性的概念，它强化了传统的如Agnostic Learning等概念。它要求相对于假设类的损失最小化保证（不仅适用于特定的损失函数，而是适用于一个丰富的损失族）。近期的研究表明，Omniprediction可以通过多校准以及相关的多组公平性概念来推导。这种意外的联系引发了这样一个问题：多组公平性是否是实现Omniprediction所必需的？

我们的工作首次对这一问题给出了肯定的答案。我们建立了Omniprediction的不同变体、Multicalibration以及Swap Agnostic Learning之间的等价关系。进一步地，Swap Multicalibration实际上与标准的Multicalibration等价，因此现有的学习算法可以用来实现这三种概念中的任意一种。基于这一特性，我们描绘了不同多组公平性变体、Omniprediction和Outcome Indistinguishability之间关系的完整图景。这一探究揭示了一个统一的Outcome Indistinguishability（OI）概念，它可以捕捉所有现有的Omniprediction和Multicalibration的概念。

来源: NeurIPS 2023

标题: 适配神经链接预测器以实现高效复杂的查询回答

英摘: Answering complex queries on incomplete knowledge graphs is a challenging task where a model needs to answer complex logical queries in the presence of missing knowledge. Prior work in the literature has proposed to address this problem by designing architectures trained end-to-end for the complex query answering task with a reasoning process that is hard to interpret while requiring data and resource-intensive training. Other lines of research have proposed re-using simple neural link predictors to answer complex queries, reducing the amount of training data by orders of magnitude while providing interpretable answers. 英摘: Recent work has shown that language models' (LMs) prompt-based learning capabilities make them well suited for automating data labeling in domains where manual annotation is expensive. Our work asks whether it is possible to improve prompt-based learning without additional labeled data. We approach this problem by attempting to modify the predictions of a prompt, rather than the prompt itself. Our intuition is that accurate predictions should also be consistent: samples which are similar under some feature representation should receive the same prompt prediction. However, prior ordinal CP methods mainly focus on heuristic algorithms or restrictively require the underlying model to predict a unimodal distribution over ordinal labels. Consequently, they provide limited insight into coverage-efficiency trade-offs, or a model-agnostic and distribution-free nature favored by CP methods. To gain insight into this, we use a recent theoretical framework that relates the generalization error from regression to the spectral properties of the model and the target. 标题: 超越黑盒建议：基于Q值预测的学习增强MDPs算法
类别: 
作者: Tongxin Li;Yiheng Lin;Shaolei Ren;Adam Wierman;
机构: Chinese University of Hong Kong;California Institute of Technology;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/71672
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.10524
英摘: We study the tradeoff between consistency and robustness in the context of a single-trajectory time-varying Markov Decision Process (MDP) with untrusted machine-learned advice. Our work departs from the typical approach of treating advice as coming from black-box sources by instead considering a setting where additional information about how the advice is generated is available. We prove a first-of-its-kind consistency and robustness tradeoff given Q-value advice under a general MDP model that includes both continuous and discrete state/action spaces. Our results highlight that utilizing Q-value advice enables dynamic pursuit of the better of machine-learned advice and a robust baseline, thus result in near-optimal performance guarantees, which provably improves what can be obtained solely with black-box advice.
中摘: 我们在不可信的机器学习建议的背景下研究单一轨迹时变马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）的一致性和鲁棒性之间的权衡。我们的工作不同于通常将建议视为来自黑盒源的做法，而是考虑一个额外信息可用于了解建议生成方式的环境。我们证明了在一般MDP模型下（包括连续和离散的状态/动作空间），基于Q值建议的一致性和鲁棒性权衡是前所未有的。我们的结果强调，利用Q值建议可以动态追求机器学习建议和鲁棒基线中的最优者，从而近似实现最优性能保证，这在理论上证明了与仅使用黑盒建议相比有所改进。

[No.303] Density of States Prediction of Crystalline Materials via Prompt-guided Multi-Modal Transformer
来源: NeurIPS 2023

类别: 
作者: Namkyeong Lee;Heewoong Noh;Sungwon Kim;Dongmin Hyun;Gyoung S. Na;Chanyoung Park;
机构: Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology;Korea University;Pohang University of Science and Technology;
类型: Poster

arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.12856
英摘: The density of states (DOS) is a spectral property of crystalline materials, which provides fundamental insights into various characteristics of the materials. While previous works mainly focus on obtaining high-quality representations of crystalline materials for DOS prediction, we focus on predicting the DOS from the obtained representations by reflecting the nature of DOS: DOS determines the general distribution of states as a function of energy. That is, DOS is not solely determined by the crystalline material but also by the energy levels, which has been neglected in previous works. In this paper, we propose to integrate heterogeneous information obtained from the crystalline materials and the energies via a multi-modal transformer, thereby modeling the complex relationships between the atoms in the crystalline materials and various energy levels for DOS prediction. Moreover, we propose to utilize prompts to guide the model to learn the crystal structural system-specific interactions between crystalline materials and energies. Extensive experiments on two types of DOS, i.e., Phonon DOS and Electron DOS, with various real-world scenarios demonstrate the superiority of DOSTransformer. The source code for DOSTransformer is available at https://github.com/HeewoongNoh/DOSTransformer.
中摘: 态密度（DOS）是晶体材料的一种光谱性质，提供了对材料各种特性的基本洞察。以往的工作主要集中在获得高质量的晶体材料表示以进行DOS预测上，而我们则关注于通过反映DOS的本质来预测DOS：DOS决定了能量作为函数时的状态的一般分布。也就是说，DOS不仅由晶体材料决定，还由能量水平决定，这一点在以往的工作中被忽略了。在本文中，我们提出了一种通过多模态变压器整合从晶体材料和能量中获得的异构信息的方法，从而建模晶体材料中原子之间的复杂关系以及各种能量水平之间的关系，以进行DOS预测。此外，我们提出了使用提示来引导模型学习特定于晶体结构系统的晶体材料与能量之间的交互作用。在两种类型的DOS，即声子态密度（Phonon DOS）和电子态密度（Electron DOS）的各种实际场景下的广泛实验表明，DOSTransformer具有优越性。DOSTransformer的源代码可在https://github.com/HeewoongNoh/DOSTransformer获取。

[No.304] A polar prediction model for learning to represent visual transformations
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 一种极地预测模型用于学习表示视觉变换
类别: 
作者: Pierre-Étienne H Fiquet;Eero P Simoncelli;
机构: New York University;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/70760
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.03432
英摘: All organisms make temporal predictions, and their evolutionary fitness level depends on the accuracy of these predictions. In the context of visual perception, the motions of both the observer and objects in the scene structure the dynamics of sensory signals, allowing for partial prediction of future signals based on past ones. Here, we propose a self-supervised representation-learning framework that extracts and exploits the regularities of natural videos to compute accurate predictions. We motivate the polar architecture by appealing to the Fourier shift theorem and its group-theoretic generalization, and we optimize its parameters on next-frame prediction. Through controlled experiments, we demonstrate that this approach can discover the representation of simple transformation groups acting in data. When trained on natural video datasets, our framework achieves better prediction performance than traditional motion compensation and rivals conventional deep networks, while maintaining interpretability and speed. Furthermore, the polar computations can be restructured into components resembling normalized simple and direction-selective complex cell models of primate V1 neurons. Thus, polar prediction offers a principled framework for understanding how the visual system represents sensory inputs in a form that simplifies temporal prediction.
中摘: 所有生物体都会进行时间预测，其进化适应度水平取决于这些预测的准确性。在视觉感知的背景下，观察者和场景中物体的运动结构化了感官信号的动力学，从而基于过去的信号部分预测未来的信号。在此，我们提出了一种自我监督的表示学习框架，该框架提取并利用自然视频中的规律性来计算准确的预测。我们通过引用傅里叶移位定理及其群论推广来激发极坐标架构，并在其上优化参数以进行下一帧预测。通过受控实验，我们证明了这种方法可以发现简单变换组在数据中起作用的表示形式。当在自然视频数据集上训练时，我们的框架在预测性能方面优于传统的运动补偿方法，并且与传统的深度网络相媲美，同时保持可解释性和速度。此外，极坐标计算可以重构为类似于灵长类V1神经元的规范化简单细胞和方向选择性复杂细胞模型的组件。因此，极坐标预测提供了一个有原则的框架，用于理解视觉系统如何以简化时间预测的形式表示感官输入。

[No.305] Understanding, Predicting and Better Resolving Q-Value Divergence in Offline-RL
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 理解、预测并更好地解决离线强化学习中的Q值发散问题
类别: 
作者: Yang Yue;Rui Lu;Bingyi Kang;Shiji Song;Gao Huang;
机构: Tsinghua University;Sea AI Lab;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/72727
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.04411
英摘: The divergence of the Q-value estimation has been a prominent issue in offline RL, where the agent has no access to real dynamics. Traditional beliefs attribute this instability to querying out-of-distribution actions when bootstrapping value targets. Though this issue can be alleviated with policy constraints or conservative Q estimation, a theoretical understanding of the underlying mechanism causing the divergence has been absent. In this work, we aim to thoroughly comprehend this mechanism and attain an improved solution. We first identify a fundamental pattern, self-excitation, as the primary cause of Q-value estimation divergence in offline RL. Then, we propose a novel Self-Excite Eigenvalue Measure (SEEM) metric based on Neural Tangent Kernel (NTK) to measure the evolving property of Q-network at training, which provides an intriguing explanation of the emergence of divergence. For the first time, our theory can reliably decide whether the training will diverge at an early stage, and even predict the order of the growth for the estimated Q-value, the model's norm, and the crashing step when an SGD optimizer is used. The experiments demonstrate perfect alignment with this theoretic analysis. Building on our insights, we propose to resolve divergence from a novel perspective, namely improving the model's architecture for better extrapolating behavior. Through extensive empirical studies, we identify LayerNorm as a good solution to effectively avoid divergence without introducing detrimental bias, leading to superior performance. Experimental results prove that it can still work in some most challenging settings, i.e. using only 1 transitions of the dataset, where all previous methods fail. Moreover, it can be easily plugged into modern offline RL methods and achieve SOTA results on many challenging tasks. We also give unique insights into its effectiveness.
中摘: 在离线强化学习（offline RL）中，Q值估计的发散是一个显著问题，此时代理无法访问真实的动力学。传统观点认为这种不稳定性主要是由于在自助法计算价值目标时查询了分布外的动作。尽管可以通过策略约束或保守的Q估计来缓解这一问题，但关于导致发散的根本机制的理论理解却一直缺失。本研究旨在彻底理解这一机制，并找到一个改进的解决方案。我们首先识别出自我激发作为离线RL中Q值估计发散的主要原因。然后，基于神经 tangent 核（NTK），我们提出了一个新的自激发特征值度量（SEEM）指标，用于衡量训练过程中Q网络的演变特性，这为发散现象的出现提供了一个引人注目的解释。这是首次能够可靠地在训练早期阶段决定是否会发散，并且甚至可以预测估计的Q值、模型的范数以及使用随机梯度下降（SGD）优化器时崩溃步骤的增长顺序。我们的理论可以在使用少量数据集过渡的情况下，如仅使用1个过渡，仍能可靠地决定是否会发生发散，并且在所有先前方法都失败的情况下，仍然表现出色。此外，该方法可以轻松地集成到现代离线RL方法中，并在许多具有挑战性的任务上取得SOTA（最佳）结果。我们还提供了对其有效性的独特见解。

[No.307] Crystal Structure Prediction by Joint Equivariant Diffusion
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 联合等变扩散的晶体结构预测
类别: 
作者: Rui Jiao;Wenbing Huang;Peijia Lin;Jiaqi Han;Pin Chen;Yutong Lu;Yang Liu;
机构: Tsinghua University;Renmin University of China;Sun Yat-sen University;Stanford University;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/72373
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.04475
英摘: Crystal Structure Prediction (CSP) is crucial in various scientific disciplines. While CSP can be addressed by employing currently-prevailing generative models (e.g. diffusion models), this task encounters unique challenges owing to the symmetric geometry of crystal structures -- the invariance of translation, rotation, and periodicity. To incorporate the above symmetries, this paper proposes DiffCSP, a novel diffusion model to learn the structure distribution from stable crystals. To be specific, DiffCSP jointly generates the lattice and atom coordinates for each crystal by employing a periodic-E(3)-equivariant denoising model, to better model the crystal geometry. Notably, different from related equivariant generative approaches, DiffCSP leverages fractional coordinates other than Cartesian coordinates to represent crystals, remarkably promoting the diffusion and the generation process of atom positions. Extensive experiments verify that our DiffCSP significantly outperforms existing CSP methods, with a much lower computation cost in contrast to DFT-based methods. Moreover, the superiority of DiffCSP is also observed when it is extended for ab initio crystal generation.
中摘: 晶体结构预测（CSP）在多个科学领域中至关重要。虽然可以利用现有的生成模型（如扩散模型）来解决CSP问题，但由于晶体结构具有对称几何特性——包括平移不变性、旋转不变性和周期性——这一任务遇到了独特的挑战。为了整合上述对称性，本文提出了一种名为DiffCSP的新颖扩散模型，用于从稳定晶体中学习结构分布。具体而言，DiffCSP通过使用一个周期性-E(3)对称的去噪模型，同时生成每个晶体的晶格和原子坐标，以更好地模拟晶体几何结构。值得注意的是，与相关的对称生成方法不同，DiffCSP采用分数坐标而非笛卡尔坐标来表示晶体，显著促进了原子位置的扩散和生成过程。大量实验验证了我们的DiffCSP方法在性能上显著优于现有CSP方法，并且相比于基于密度泛函理论（DFT）的方法，计算成本更低。此外，当将DiffCSP扩展应用于从头计算晶体生成时，其优越性也得到了进一步证实。

[No.310] Sorting with Predictions
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 预测排序
类别: 
作者: Xingjian Bai;Christian Coester;
机构: University of Oxford;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/71687
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.00749
英摘: We explore the fundamental problem of sorting through the lens of learning-augmented algorithms, where algorithms can leverage possibly erroneous predictions to improve their efficiency. We consider two different settings: In the first setting, each item is provided a prediction of its position in the sorted list. In the second setting, we assume there is a "quick-and-dirty" way of comparing items, in addition to slow-and-exact comparisons. For both settings, we design new and simple algorithms using only $O(\sum_i \log η_i)$ exact comparisons, where $η_i$ is a suitably defined prediction error for the $i$th element. In particular, as the quality of predictions deteriorates, the number of comparisons degrades smoothly from $O(n)$ to $O(n\log n)$. We prove that the comparison complexity is theoretically optimal with respect to the examined error measures. An experimental evaluation against existing adaptive and non-adaptive sorting algorithms demonstrates the potential of applying learning-augmented algorithms in sorting tasks.
中摘: 我们通过学习增强型算法的视角探讨排序的基本问题，其中算法可以利用可能错误的预测来提高其效率。我们考虑了两种不同的设置：在第一种设置中，每项都会提供其在排序列表中位置的预测；在第二种设置中，假设有一种“快速而粗糙”的项目比较方法，除了传统的慢而精确的比较之外。对于这两种设置，我们仅使用$O(\sum_i \log η_i)$次精确比较设计了新的简单算法，其中$η_i$是第$i$个元素的预测误差定义。特别是，随着预测质量的下降，比较次数会平滑地从$O(n)$减少到$O(n\log n)$。我们证明了比较复杂度在检查的误差衡量标准方面是理论上最优的。与现有的自适应和非自适应排序算法的实验评估表明，在排序任务中应用学习增强型算法具有潜力。

[No.313] Koopa: Learning Non-stationary Time Series Dynamics with Koopman Predictors
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 科帕：使用科普曼预测器学习非平稳时间序列动力学
类别: 
作者: Yong Liu;Chenyu Li;Jianmin Wang;Mingsheng Long;
机构: Tsinghua University;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/72562
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.18803
英摘: Real-world time series are characterized by intrinsic non-stationarity that poses a principal challenge for deep forecasting models. While previous models suffer from complicated series variations induced by changing temporal distribution, we tackle non-stationary time series with modern Koopman theory that fundamentally considers the underlying time-variant dynamics. Inspired by Koopman theory of portraying complex dynamical systems, we disentangle time-variant and time-invariant components from intricate non-stationary series by Fourier Filter and design Koopman Predictor to advance respective dynamics forward. Technically, we propose Koopa as a novel Koopman forecaster composed of stackable blocks that learn hierarchical dynamics. Koopa seeks measurement functions for Koopman embedding and utilizes Koopman operators as linear portraits of implicit transition. To cope with time-variant dynamics that exhibits strong locality, Koopa calculates context-aware operators in the temporal neighborhood and is able to utilize incoming ground truth to scale up forecast horizon. Besides, by integrating Koopman Predictors into deep residual structure, we ravel out the binding reconstruction loss in previous Koopman forecasters and achieve end-to-end forecasting objective optimization. Compared with the state-of-the-art model, Koopa achieves competitive performance while saving 77.3% training time and 76.0% memory.
中摘: 实际时间序列具有内在的非平稳性，这为深度预测模型带来了主要挑战。尽管以往的模型受到由时间分布变化引起的复杂序列变化的影响，我们利用现代Koopman理论来处理非平稳时间序列，该理论从根本上考虑了潜在的时间变异动力学。受Koopman理论描述复杂动力系统理念的启发，我们通过傅里叶滤波器从复杂的非平稳序列中分离出时间变异和时间不变成分，并设计Koopman预测器以分别推进这些动力学。技术上，我们提出Koopa作为一种新颖的Koopman预测器，它由可堆叠的模块组成，学习层次化动力学。Koopa 寻找用于Koopman嵌入的度量函数，并利用Koopman算子作为隐式转换的线性表示。为了应对表现出强烈局部性的时变动力学，Koopa 在时间邻域内计算上下文感知算子，并能够利用新来的真实数据来扩展预测范围。此外，通过将Koopman预测器整合到深层残差结构中，我们解决了以往Koopman预测器中的绑定重构损失问题，并实现了端到端的预测目标优化。与最先进的模型相比，Koopa 在训练时间和内存使用方面分别节省了77.3%和76.0%，但仍能实现竞争力的表现。

[No.314] Sequential Predictive Two-Sample and Independence Testing
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 序贯预测性两样本和独立性检验
类别: 
作者: Aleksandr Podkopaev;Aaditya Ramdas;
机构: Carnegie Mellon University;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/71151
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.00143
英摘: We study the problems of sequential nonparametric two-sample and independence testing. Sequential tests process data online and allow using observed data to decide whether to stop and reject the null hypothesis or to collect more data, while maintaining type I error control. We build upon the principle of (nonparametric) testing by betting, where a gambler places bets on future observations and their wealth measures evidence against the null hypothesis. While recently developed kernel-based betting strategies often work well on simple distributions, selecting a suitable kernel for high-dimensional or structured data, such as images, is often nontrivial. To address this drawback, we design prediction-based betting strategies that rely on the following fact: if a sequentially updated predictor starts to consistently determine (a) which distribution an instance is drawn from, or (b) whether an instance is drawn from the joint distribution or the product of the marginal distributions (the latter produced by external randomization), it provides evidence against the two-sample or independence nulls respectively. We empirically demonstrate the superiority of our tests over kernel-based approaches under structured settings. Our tests can be applied beyond the case of independent and identically distributed data, remaining valid and powerful even when the data distribution drifts over time.
中摘: 我们研究序贯非参数两样本和独立性检验的问题。序贯检验在线处理数据，并允许根据观测数据决定是否停止并拒绝原假设，或者继续收集更多数据，同时保持第一类错误控制。我们基于“测试下注”的原则进行构建，其中赌徒对未来的观察结果下注，其财富衡量了证据反对原假设的程度。虽然最近开发的核方法下注策略在简单分布上通常表现良好，但对于高维或结构化数据（如图像）来说，选择合适的核往往并不容易。为解决这一问题，我们设计了一种基于预测的下注策略，该策略依赖于以下事实：如果一个顺序更新的预测器开始一致地确定（a）某个实例是从哪个分布中抽取的，或者（b）某个实例是来自联合分布还是边缘分布的乘积（后者通过外部随机化生成），那么它将分别提供反对两样本或独立性原假设的证据。我们在结构化设置下实证展示了我们的测试方法优于基于核的方法。我们的测试方法不仅适用于独立同分布的数据，即使在数据分布随时间漂移的情况下也能保持有效性和强大的检验能力。

英摘: Counterfactual fairness requires that a person would have been classified in the same way by an AI or other algorithmic system if they had a different protected class, such as a different race or gender. This is an intuitive standard, as reflected in the U.S. legal system, but its use is limited because counterfactuals cannot be directly observed in real-world data. On the other hand, group fairness metrics (e.g., demographic parity or equalized odds) are less intuitive but more readily observed. In this paper, we use $\textit{causal context}$ to bridge the gaps between counterfactual fairness, robust prediction, and group fairness. First, we motivate counterfactual fairness by showing that there is not necessarily a fundamental trade-off between fairness and accuracy because, under plausible conditions, the counterfactually fair predictor is in fact accuracy-optimal in an unbiased target distribution. Second, we develop a correspondence between the causal graph of the data-generating process and which, if any, group fairness metrics are equivalent to counterfactual fairness. Here we propose Graph Segment Training (GST), a general framework that utilizes a divide-and-conquer approach to allow learning large graph property prediction with a constant memory footprint. GST first divides a large graph into segments and then backpropagates through only a few segments sampled per training iteration. We refine the GST paradigm by introducing a historical embedding table to efficiently obtain embeddings for segments not sampled for backpropagation. To mitigate the staleness of historical embeddings, we design two novel techniques. First, we finetune the prediction head to fix the input distribution shift. Second, we introduce Stale Embedding Dropout to drop some stale embeddings during training to reduce bias. We evaluate our complete method GST-EFD (with all the techniques together) on two large graph property prediction benchmarks: MalNet and TpuGraphs. Our experiments show that GST-EFD is both memory-efficient and fast, while offering a slight boost on test accuracy over a typical full graph training regime.

来源: NeurIPS 2023

类别:

Prior works have studied this framework when $m=1$ and provided incentive-compatible no-regret algorithms for the problem. We first show that a simple reduction of our problem to the $m=1$ setting is neither efficient nor effective. Then, we provide algorithms that utilize the specific structure of the utility functions to achieve the two desired goals.

[No.331] Large language models implicitly learn to straighten neural sentence trajectories to construct a predictive representation of natural language.
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 大型语言模型会隐式地学习调整神经句子轨迹，以构建对自然语言的预测性表示。
类别: 
作者: Eghbal A. Hosseini;Evelina Fedorenko;
机构: Massachusetts Institute of Technology;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/70807
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.04930
英摘: Predicting upcoming events is critical to our ability to interact with our environment. Transformer models, trained on next-word prediction, appear to construct representations of linguistic input that can support diverse downstream tasks. But how does a predictive objective shape such representations? Inspired by recent work in vision (Henaff et al., 2019), we test a hypothesis about predictive representations of autoregressive transformers. In particular, we test whether the neural trajectory of a sentence becomes progressively straighter as it passes through the network layers. The key insight is that straighter trajectories should facilitate prediction via linear extrapolation. We quantify straightness using a 1-dimensional curvature metric, and present four findings in support of the trajectory straightening hypothesis: i) In trained models, the curvature decreases from the early to the deeper layers of the network. ii) Models that perform better on the next-word prediction objective exhibit greater decreases in curvature, suggesting that this improved ability to straighten sentence trajectories may be the driver of better language modeling performance. iii) Given the same linguistic context, the sequences that are generated by the model have lower curvature than the actual continuations observed in a language corpus, suggesting that the model favors straighter trajectories for making predictions. iv) A consistent relationship holds between the average curvature and the average surprisal of sentences in the deep model layers, such that sentences with straighter trajectories also have lower surprisal. Importantly, untrained models do not exhibit these behaviors. In tandem, these results support the trajectory straightening hypothesis and provide a possible mechanism for how the geometry of the internal representations of autoregressive models supports next word prediction.
中摘: 预测即将发生的事件是我们与环境互动能力的关键。经过下一个词预测训练的变压器模型似乎能够构建支持多种下游任务的语言输入表示。但这种预测目标如何塑造这些表示呢？受近期视觉领域研究（Henaff等人，2019）的启发，我们测试了一个关于自回归变压器预测表示的假设。具体而言，我们测试的是句子的神经轨迹是否随着网络层的加深而变得越来越直线。关键洞察是，更直线的轨迹应该有助于通过线性外推进行预测。我们使用一维曲率度量来量化直线度，并提出了四项支持轨迹直线化假设的研究发现：i）在训练好的模型中，曲率从网络的早期层逐渐降低至更深的层。ii）在下一个词预测目标上表现更好的模型显示出更大的曲率下降，这表明这种改善的轨迹直线化能力可能是语言建模性能提升的驱动因素。iii）在相同的语言上下文中，模型生成的序列的曲率低于实际语言语料中观察到的后续内容的曲率，这表明模型倾向于选择更直线的轨迹来进行预测。iv）深层模型层中句子的平均曲率与其平均惊讶度之间存在一致的关系，即具有更直线轨迹的句子也具有更低的惊讶度。重要的是，未训练的模型并未表现出这些行为。这些结果共同支持了轨迹直线化假设，并提供了一种可能的机制，说明自回归模型内部表示的几何结构如何支持下一个词的预测。

[No.334] Predict-then-Calibrate: A New Perspective of Robust Contextual LP
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 预测然后校准：鲁棒上下文线性规划的新视角
类别: 
作者: Chunlin Sun;Linyu Liu;Xiaocheng Li;
机构: Stanford University;Tsinghua University;Imperial College London;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/71538
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.15686
英摘: Contextual optimization, also known as predict-then-optimize or prescriptive analytics, considers an optimization problem with the presence of covariates (context or side information). The goal is to learn a prediction model (from the training data) that predicts the objective function from the covariates, and then in the test phase, solve the optimization problem with the covariates but without the observation of the objective function. In this paper, we consider a risk-sensitive version of the problem and propose a generic algorithm design paradigm called predict-then-calibrate. The idea is to first develop a prediction model without concern for the downstream risk profile or robustness guarantee, and then utilize calibration (or recalibration) methods to quantify the uncertainty of the prediction. While the existing methods suffer from either a restricted choice of the prediction model or strong assumptions on the underlying data, we show the disentangling of the prediction model and the calibration/uncertainty quantification has several advantages. First, it imposes no restriction on the prediction model and thus fully unleashes the potential of off-the-shelf machine learning methods. Second, the derivation of the risk and robustness guarantee can be made independent of the choice of the prediction model through a data-splitting idea. Third, our paradigm of predict-then-calibrate applies to both (risk-sensitive) robust and (risk-neutral) distributionally robust optimization (DRO) formulations. Theoretically, it gives new generalization bounds for the contextual LP problem and sheds light on the existing results of DRO for contextual LP. Numerical experiments further reinforce the advantage of the predict-then-calibrate paradigm in that an improvement on either the prediction model or the calibration model will lead to a better final performance.
中摘: 上下文优化，也被称为预测-优化或规范分析，考虑的是在有协变量（上下文或辅助信息）的情况下解决优化问题。目标是从训练数据中学习一个预测模型，该模型能够根据协变量预测目标函数，然后在测试阶段使用协变量但不观察目标函数来解决优化问题。在本文中，我们考虑了这个问题的风险敏感版本，并提出了一种通用的算法设计范式，称为预测-校准。其思想是首先开发一个预测模型，不考虑下游的风险特征或鲁棒性保证，然后通过校准（或重新校准）方法来量化预测的不确定性。尽管现有的方法要么限制了预测模型的选择范围，要么对底层数据做出了强烈的假设，但我们展示了将预测模型与校准/不确定性量化分离有几个优势。首先，这种方法不对预测模型施加任何限制，从而完全释放了现成机器学习方法的潜力。其次，风险和鲁棒性的保证可以通过数据划分的想法独立于预测模型的选择进行推导。第三，我们的预测-校准范式适用于两种类型的优化形式：风险敏感的稳健优化和风险中性的分布鲁棒优化（DRO）。理论上，它为上下文线性规划问题提供了新的泛化界，并为上下文线性规划的现有DRO结果提供了新的见解。数值实验进一步证实了预测-校准范式的优点，即无论是改进预测模型还是校准模型，都可能导致更好的最终性能。

[No.336] Stability of Random Forests and Coverage of Random-Forest Prediction Intervals
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 随机森林的稳定性与随机森林预测区间覆盖范围
类别: 
作者: Yan Wang;Huaiqing Wu;Dan Nettleton;
机构: Iowa State University;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/70008
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.18814
英摘: We establish stability of random forests under the mild condition that the squared response ($Y^2$) does not have a heavy tail. In particular, our analysis holds for the practical version of random forests that is implemented in popular packages like \texttt{randomForest} in \texttt{R}. Empirical results show that stability may persist even beyond our assumption and hold for heavy-tailed $Y^2$. Using the stability property, we prove a non-asymptotic lower bound for the coverage probability of prediction intervals constructed from the out-of-bag error of random forests. With another mild condition that is typically satisfied when $Y$ is continuous, we also establish a complementary upper bound, which can be similarly established for the jackknife prediction interval constructed from an arbitrary stable algorithm. We also discuss the asymptotic coverage probability under assumptions weaker than those considered in previous literature. Our work implies that random forests, with its stability property, is an effective machine learning method that can provide not only satisfactory point prediction but also justified interval prediction at almost no extra computational cost.
中摘: 我们在轻度条件下建立了随机森林的稳定性，即响应变量（$Y^2$）的平方不具有重尾特性。特别地，我们的分析适用于在流行包如R中的`randomForest`实现的实际版本的随机森林。实证结果显示，即使超出我们的假设，随机森林的稳定性也可能在重尾$Y^2$的情况下保持有效。利用稳定性性质，我们证明了从随机森林的袋外错误构建的预测区间覆盖概率的非渐近下界。另外，在$Y$为连续变量时通常满足的一个轻度条件下，我们也建立了互补的上界，这同样可以应用于任意稳定算法构建的自助法预测区间。我们还讨论了在比之前文献中考虑的假设更弱的情况下，随机森林的渐近覆盖概率。我们的研究表明，随机森林凭借其稳定性特性，是一种有效的机器学习方法，不仅能够提供满意的点预测，还能在几乎不增加额外计算成本的情况下提供合理的区间预测。

[No.337] Learning Rule-Induced Subgraph Representations for Inductive Relation Prediction
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 学习规则诱导子图表示以进行归纳关系预测
类别: 
作者: Tianyu Liu;Qitan Lv;Jie Wang;Shuling Yang;Hanzhu Chen;
机构: University of Science and Technology of China;South China University of Technology;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/71668
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.07088
英摘: Inductive relation prediction (IRP) -- where entities can be different during training and inference -- has shown great power for completing evolving knowledge graphs. Existing works mainly focus on using graph neural networks (GNNs) to learn the representation of the subgraph induced from the target link, which can be seen as an implicit rule-mining process to measure the plausibility of the target link. However, these methods cannot differentiate the target link and other links during message passing, hence the final subgraph representation will contain irrelevant rule information to the target link, which reduces the reasoning performance and severely hinders the applications for real-world scenarios. To tackle this problem, we propose a novel \textit{single-source edge-wise} GNN model to learn the \textbf{R}ule-induc\textbf{E}d \textbf{S}ubgraph represen\textbf{T}ations (\textbf{REST}), which encodes relevant rules and eliminates irrelevant rules within the subgraph. Specifically, we propose a \textit{single-source} initialization approach to initialize edge features only for the target link, which guarantees the relevance of mined rules and target link. Then we propose several RNN-based functions for \textit{edge-wise} message passing to model the sequential property of mined rules. REST is a simple and effective approach with theoretical support to learn the \textit{rule-induced subgraph representation}. Moreover, REST does not need node labeling, which significantly accelerates the subgraph preprocessing time by up to \textbf{11.66$\times$}. Experiments on inductive relation prediction benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of our REST. Our code is available at https://github.com/smart-lty/REST.
中摘: 归纳关系预测（IRP）——在训练和推理过程中实体可以不同——已被证明对于完成演变的知识图谱具有巨大潜力。现有工作主要集中在使用图神经网络（GNNs）来学习目标链接诱导子图的表示，这可以被视为一个隐式的规则挖掘过程，用于衡量目标链接的合理性。然而，这些方法在消息传递过程中无法区分目标链接和其他链接，因此最终的子图表示将包含与目标链接无关的规则信息，这会降低推理性能，并严重影响实际应用场景中的应用。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新颖的“单源边级”GNN模型，以学习规则诱导的子图表示（Rule-inducEd Subgraph represenTations，简称REST），该模型在子图内部编码相关规则并消除无关规则。具体而言，我们提出了一种“单源”初始化方法，仅为目标链接初始化边特征，从而保证挖掘出的规则和目标链接的相关性。然后，我们提出了几种基于RNN的功能来进行“边级”的消息传递，以建模挖掘出的规则的顺序特性。REST是一种简单且有效的具有理论支持的方法，用于学习规则诱导的子图表示。此外，REST不需要节点标签，这可以将子图预处理时间显著加速至最高11.66倍。我们在归纳关系预测基准上的实验表明了REST的有效性。我们的代码可在https://github.com/smart-lty/REST获取。

[No.338] Predict, Refine, Synthesize: Self-Guiding Diffusion Models for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 预测、细化、合成：自我引导扩散模型在概率时间序列预测中的应用
类别: 
作者: Marcel Kollovieh;Abdul Fatir Ansari;Michael Bohlke-Schneider;Jasper Zschiegner;Hao Wang;Bernie Wang;
机构: Amazon;Rutgers University;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/70377
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.11494
英摘: Diffusion models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in generative modeling tasks across various domains. Prior works on time series diffusion models have primarily focused on developing conditional models tailored to specific forecasting or imputation tasks. In this work, we explore the potential of task-agnostic, unconditional diffusion models for several time series applications. We propose TSDiff, an unconditionally-trained diffusion model for time series. Our proposed self-guidance mechanism enables conditioning TSDiff for downstream tasks during inference, without requiring auxiliary networks or altering the training procedure. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our method on three different time series tasks: forecasting, refinement, and synthetic data generation. First, we show that TSDiff is competitive with several task-specific conditional forecasting methods (predict). Second, we leverage the learned implicit probability density of TSDiff to iteratively refine the predictions of base forecasters with reduced computational overhead over reverse diffusion (refine). Notably, the generative performance of the model remains intact -- downstream forecasters trained on synthetic samples from TSDiff outperform forecasters that are trained on samples from other state-of-the-art generative time series models, occasionally even outperforming models trained on real data (synthesize).
中摘: 扩散模型在生成建模任务的各种领域中已经实现了最先进的性能。先前关于时间序列扩散模型的研究主要集中在开发针对特定预测或插补任务的条件模型上。而在本研究中，我们探索了任务无关、无条件扩散模型在多个时间序列应用中的潜力。我们提出了TSDiff，这是一种用于时间序列的无条件训练扩散模型。我们提出的自我引导机制能够在推理过程中为TSDiff进行条件化，而无需辅助网络或改变训练过程。我们在三个不同的时间序列任务上展示了我们方法的有效性：预测、细化和合成数据生成。首先，我们表明TSDiff与几种特定任务的条件预测方法具有竞争力（预测）。其次，我们利用TSDiff学习到的隐含概率密度，以较低的计算开销迭代细化基础预测器的预测（细化）。值得注意的是，模型的生成性能保持不变——基于TSDiff生成样本训练的下游预测器优于基于其他先进生成时间序列模型样本训练的预测器，有时甚至优于基于真实数据训练的模型（合成）。

[No.339] Sequential Memory with Temporal Predictive Coding
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 序列记忆与时间预测编码
类别: 
作者: Mufeng Tang;Helen Barron;Rafal Bogacz;
机构: University of Oxford;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/70917
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.11982
英摘: Forming accurate memory of sequential stimuli is a fundamental function of biological agents. However, the computational mechanism underlying sequential memory in the brain remains unclear. Inspired by neuroscience theories and recent successes in applying predictive coding (PC) to \emph{static} memory tasks, in this work we propose a novel PC-based model for \emph{sequential} memory, called \emph{temporal predictive coding} (tPC). We show that our tPC models can memorize and retrieve sequential inputs accurately with a biologically plausible neural implementation. Importantly, our analytical study reveals that tPC can be viewed as a classical Asymmetric Hopfield Network (AHN) with an implicit statistical whitening process, which leads to more stable performance in sequential memory tasks of structured inputs. Moreover, we find that tPC exhibits properties consistent with behavioral observations and theories in neuroscience, thereby strengthening its biological relevance. Our work establishes a possible computational mechanism underlying sequential memory in the brain that can also be theoretically interpreted using existing memory model frameworks.
中摘: 形成准确的序列刺激记忆是生物代理的基本功能之一。然而，大脑中支撑序列记忆的计算机制仍然不清楚。受神经科学理论和近期将预测编码（PC）应用于静态记忆任务的成功启发，本文提出了一种新的基于预测编码的序列记忆模型，称为时间预测编码（tPC）。我们展示了我们的tPC模型可以通过生物学上可行的神经实现准确地存储和检索序列输入。更重要的是，我们的分析研究表明，tPC可以被视为一个具有隐含统计白化过程的经典非对称霍普菲尔德网络（AHN），这使得tPC在处理结构化输入的序列记忆任务时表现出更稳定的性能。此外，我们发现tPC表现出与神经科学中的行为观察和理论一致的特性，从而增强了其生物学相关性。我们的研究工作为大脑中潜在的序列记忆计算机制奠定了基础，并且可以通过现有的记忆模型框架进行理论解释。

[No.342] Initialization-Dependent Sample Complexity of Linear Predictors and Neural Networks
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 基于初始化的数据依赖线性预测器和神经网络的样本复杂度
类别: 
作者: Roey Magen;Ohad Shamir;
机构: Weizmann Institute of Science;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/70401
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.16475
英摘: We provide several new results on the sample complexity of vector-valued linear predictors (parameterized by a matrix), and more generally neural networks. Focusing on size-independent bounds, where only the Frobenius norm distance of the parameters from some fixed reference matrix $W_0$ is controlled, we show that the sample complexity behavior can be surprisingly different than what we may expect considering the well-studied setting of scalar-valued linear predictors. [No.343] Agnostically Learning Single-Index Models using Omnipredictors
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 使用全预测器自洽性学习单指模型
类别: 
作者: Aravind Gollakota;Parikshit Gopalan;Adam Klivans;Konstantinos Stavropoulos;
机构: University of Texas at Austin;Apple;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/70885
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.10615
英摘: We give the first result for agnostically learning Single-Index Models (SIMs) with arbitrary monotone and Lipschitz activations. All prior work either held only in the realizable setting or required the activation to be known. Moreover, we only require the marginal to have bounded second moments, whereas all prior work required stronger distributional assumptions (such as anticoncentration or boundedness). Our algorithm is based on recent work by [GHK$^+$23] on omniprediction using predictors satisfying calibrated multiaccuracy. Our analysis is simple and relies on the relationship between Bregman divergences (or matching losses) and $\ell_p$ distances. We also provide new guarantees for standard algorithms like GLMtron and logistic regression in the agnostic setting.
中摘: 我们首次在泛化学习框架下展示了单指针模型（Single-Index Models，SIMs）具有任意单调和Lipschitz激活函数的学习结果。此前的所有工作要么仅适用于可实现性假设的情境，要么需要激活函数已知。此外，我们只需假设边际分布的二次矩有界，而此前的所有工作则需要更强的分布假设（如反集中性或有界性）。我们的算法基于[GHK$^+$23]近期关于使用满足校准多准确性的预测器进行无所不包预测的工作。我们的分析非常简单，并依赖于Bregman发散（或匹配损失）与$\ell_p$距离之间的关系。我们还为标准算法如GLMtron和逻辑回归在泛化学习设置下的表现提供了新的保证。

[No.344] Collaborative Learning via Prediction Consensus
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 协作学习通过预测共识
类别: 
作者: Dongyang Fan;Celestine Mendler-Dünner;Martin Jaggi;
机构: EPFL;Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/71619
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.18497
英摘: We consider a collaborative learning setting where the goal of each agent is to improve their own model by leveraging the expertise of collaborators, in addition to their own training data. To facilitate the exchange of expertise among agents, we propose a distillation-based method leveraging shared unlabeled auxiliary data, which is pseudo-labeled by the collective. Central to our method is a trust weighting scheme that serves to adaptively weigh the influence of each collaborator on the pseudo-labels until a consensus on how to label the auxiliary data is reached. We demonstrate empirically that our collaboration scheme is able to significantly boost the performance of individual models in the target domain from which the auxiliary data is sampled. By design, our method adeptly accommodates heterogeneity in model architectures and substantially reduces communication overhead compared to typical collaborative learning methods. At the same time, it can provably mitigate the negative impact of bad models on the collective.
中摘: 我们考虑一个协作学习的环境，在这种环境中，每个代理的目标是通过利用合作者的专业知识来改进自己的模型，同时结合自身的训练数据。为了促进代理之间专业知识的交流，我们提出了一种基于蒸馏的方法，利用共享的未标记辅助数据，并由集体进行伪标签标注。我们方法的核心是一个信任加权方案，该方案能够自适应地评估每个合作者对伪标签的影响，直到就如何标注辅助数据达成共识。我们通过实验验证了我们的协作方案能够在目标领域显著提升个体模型的性能。由于设计原因，我们的方法能够很好地应对模型架构之间的异质性，并且与典型的协作学习方法相比，大大减少了通信开销。同时，它能够证明性地减轻不良模型对整体的负面影响。

[No.347] Zero-Regret Performative Prediction Under Inequality Constraints
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 零遗憾表现性预测下的不等式约束
类别: 
作者: Wenjing Yan;Xuanyu Cao;
机构: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/72333
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.12618
英摘: Performative prediction is a recently proposed framework where predictions guide decision-making and hence influence future data distributions. Such performative phenomena are ubiquitous in various areas, such as transportation, finance, public policy, and recommendation systems. To date, work on performative prediction has only focused on unconstrained scenarios, neglecting the fact that many real-world learning problems are subject to constraints. This paper bridges this gap by studying performative prediction under inequality constraints. Unlike most existing work that provides only performative stable points, we aim to find the optimal solutions. Anticipating performative gradients is a challenging task, due to the agnostic performative effect on data distributions. To address this issue, we first develop a robust primal-dual framework that requires only approximate gradients up to a certain accuracy, yet delivers the same order of performance as the stochastic primal-dual algorithm without performativity. Based on this framework, we then propose an adaptive primal-dual algorithm for location families. Our analysis demonstrates that the proposed adaptive primal-dual algorithm attains $\ca{O}(\sqrt{T})$ regret and constraint violations, using only $\sqrt{T} + 2T$ samples, where $T$ is the time horizon. To our best knowledge, this is the first study and analysis on the optimality of the performative prediction problem under inequality constraints. Finally, we validate the effectiveness of our algorithm and theoretical results through numerical simulations.
中摘: 表演性预测是一种最近提出的框架，其中预测引导决策并因此影响未来数据分布。此类表演性现象在各个领域都很普遍，如交通、金融、公共政策和推荐系统等。截至目前，关于表演性预测的研究仅集中在无约束场景上，忽略了许多实际学习问题受到约束的事实。本文通过研究不等式约束下的表演性预测来弥补这一缺口。与大多数现有工作仅提供稳定点不同，我们旨在找到最优解。预测未来的表演性梯度是一个具有挑战性的任务，因为数据分布对表演性效应持保留态度。为了解决这个问题，我们首先开发了一个鲁棒的对偶原始框架，该框架只需要某些精度范围内的近似梯度，就能达到与非表演性随机原始对偶算法相同级别的性能。基于此框架，我们随后提出了一个针对位置族的自适应原始对偶算法。我们的分析表明，所提出的自适应原始对偶算法在时间区间为$T$的情况下，仅使用$\sqrt{T} + 2T$个样本，就可实现$\ca{O}(\sqrt{T})$的遗憾和约束违反。据我们所知，这是首次对不等式约束下的表演性预测问题的最优性进行研究和分析。最后，我们通过数值模拟验证了我们算法和理论结果的有效性。

[No.348] Goal-Conditioned Predictive Coding for Offline Reinforcement Learning
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 基于目标条件的预测编码在离线强化学习中的应用
类别: 
作者: Zilai Zeng;Ce Zhang;Shijie Wang;Chen Sun;
机构: Brown University;Google;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/72131
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.03406
英摘: Recent work has demonstrated the effectiveness of formulating decision making as supervised learning on offline-collected trajectories. Powerful sequence models, such as GPT or BERT, are often employed to encode the trajectories. However, the benefits of performing sequence modeling on trajectory data remain unclear. In this work, we investigate whether sequence modeling has the ability to condense trajectories into useful representations that enhance policy learning. We adopt a two-stage framework that first leverages sequence models to encode trajectory-level representations, and then learns a goal-conditioned policy employing the encoded representations as its input. This formulation allows us to consider many existing supervised offline RL methods as specific instances of our framework. Within this framework, we introduce Goal-Conditioned Predictive Coding (GCPC), a sequence modeling objective that yields powerful trajectory representations and leads to performant policies. Through extensive empirical evaluations on AntMaze, FrankaKitchen and Locomotion environments, we observe that sequence modeling can have a significant impact on challenging decision making tasks. Furthermore, we demonstrate that GCPC learns a goal-conditioned latent representation encoding the future trajectory, which enables competitive performance on all three benchmarks.
中摘: 近期的研究表明，将决策制定表述为对离线收集轨迹的监督学习可以有效提升决策能力。强大的序列模型，如GPT或BERT，常被用来编码这些轨迹。然而，序列建模在轨迹数据上的优势仍然不明确。在本文中，我们研究了序列建模是否有能力将轨迹浓缩成有用的表现形式，从而增强策略学习的效果。我们采用两阶段框架：首先利用序列模型编码轨迹级别的表示，然后使用这些编码表示来学习一个基于目标的策略。这种表述方式使我们可以将许多现有的监督离线强化学习方法视为我们框架的具体实例。在这一框架内，我们引入了一种名为目标条件预测编码（GCPC）的序列建模目标，该目标能够生成强大的轨迹表示，并导致性能出色的策略。通过在AntMaze、FrankaKitchen和Locomotion环境中的广泛实证评估，我们发现序列建模在处理具有挑战性的决策任务时可以产生显著影响。此外，我们证明GCPC能够学习一种目标条件的潜在表示，该表示包含了未来的轨迹信息，从而在所有三个基准测试中实现了竞争力的性能。

[No.349] Class-Conditional Conformal Prediction with Many Classes
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 多类别条件自适应预测
类别: 
作者: Tiffany Ding;Anastasios Nikolas Angelopoulos;Stephen Bates;Michael Jordan;Ryan Tibshirani;
机构: University of California, Berkeley;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/70548
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.09335
英摘: Standard conformal prediction methods provide a marginal coverage guarantee, which means that for a random test point, the conformal prediction set contains the true label with a user-specified probability. In many classification problems, we would like to obtain a stronger guarantee--that for test points of a specific class, the prediction set contains the true label with the same user-chosen probability. For the latter goal, existing conformal prediction methods do not work well when there is a limited amount of labeled data per class, as is often the case in real applications where the number of classes is large. We propose a method called clustered conformal prediction that clusters together classes having "similar" conformal scores and performs conformal prediction at the cluster level. Based on empirical evaluation across four image data sets with many (up to 1000) classes, we find that clustered conformal typically outperforms existing methods in terms of class-conditional coverage and set size metrics.
中摘: 标准的容错预测方法提供了一个边际覆盖保证，这意味着对于一个随机测试点，容错预测集包含真实标签的概率为用户指定的概率。在许多分类问题中，我们希望能够获得更强的保证——即对于特定类别的测试点，预测集包含真实标签的概率与用户选择的一致。为了实现这一目标，现有的容错预测方法在每类别标注数据有限的情况下表现不佳，这在实际应用中经常发生，尤其是当类别的数量很大时。我们提出了一种称为聚类容错预测的方法，该方法将具有“相似”容错评分的类别聚类，并在聚类级别上进行容错预测。基于对四个具有大量（多达1000个）类别的图像数据集的实证评估，我们发现聚类容错预测通常在类别条件覆盖和集合大小指标方面优于现有方法。

[No.351] A Theory of Link Prediction via Relational Weisfeiler-Leman on Knowledge Graphs
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 基于关系weisfeiler-leman的知识图谱链接预测理论
类别: 
作者: Xingyue Huang;Miguel Romero Orth;Ismail Ilkan Ceylan;Pablo Barcelo;
机构: University of Oxford;Universidad Adolfo Ibañez;Pontificia Universidad Católica;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/72690
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.02209
英摘: Graph neural networks are prominent models for representation learning over graph-structured data. While the capabilities and limitations of these models are well-understood for simple graphs, our understanding remains incomplete in the context of knowledge graphs. Our goal is to provide a systematic understanding of the landscape of graph neural networks for knowledge graphs pertaining to the prominent task of link prediction. Our analysis entails a unifying perspective on seemingly unrelated models and unlocks a series of other models. The expressive power of various models is characterized via a corresponding relational Weisfeiler-Leman algorithm. This analysis is extended to provide a precise logical characterization of the class of functions captured by a class of graph neural networks. The theoretical findings presented in this paper explain the benefits of some widely employed practical design choices, which are validated empirically.
中摘: 图神经网络是处理图结构数据的表示学习的突出模型。虽然这些模型在简单图上的能力和局限性已经被很好地理解，但在知识图谱的背景下，我们对它们的理解仍然不够完整。我们的目标是为知识图谱中的链接预测这一重要任务提供一个系统性的图神经网络景观理解。我们的分析提供了一个统一的观点，将看似无关的模型联系起来，并解锁了一系列其他模型。通过相应的关系韦斯菲尔德-莱曼算法，各种模型的表达能力得到了刻画。该分析进一步扩展，以提供一个精确的逻辑刻画，说明一类图神经网络所捕获的功能。本文中的理论发现解释了一些广泛采用的实际设计选择的好处，并且这些发现得到了实证验证。

[No.352] Adversarial Resilience in Sequential Prediction via Abstention
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 通过弃权实现顺序预测中的对抗鲁棒性
类别: 
作者: Surbhi Goel;Steve Hanneke;Shay Moran;Abhishek Shetty;
机构: University of Pennsylvania;Purdue University;Google;University of California, Berkeley;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/69996
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.13119
英摘: We study the problem of sequential prediction in the stochastic setting with an adversary that is allowed to inject clean-label adversarial (or out-of-distribution) examples. Algorithms designed to handle purely stochastic data tend to fail in the presence of such adversarial examples, often leading to erroneous predictions. This is undesirable in many high-stakes applications such as medical recommendations, where abstaining from predictions on adversarial examples is preferable to misclassification. On the other hand, assuming fully adversarial data leads to very pessimistic bounds that are often vacuous in practice.
  To capture this motivation, we propose a new model of sequential prediction that sits between the purely stochastic and fully adversarial settings by allowing the learner to abstain from making a prediction at no cost on adversarial examples. Assuming access to the marginal distribution on the non-adversarial examples, we design a learner whose error scales with the VC dimension (mirroring the stochastic setting) of the hypothesis class, as opposed to the Littlestone dimension which characterizes the fully adversarial setting. Furthermore, we design a learner for VC dimension~1 classes, which works even in the absence of access to the marginal distribution. Our key technical contribution is a novel measure for quantifying uncertainty for learning VC classes, which may be of independent interest.
中摘: 我们研究在允许对手注入干净标签的对抗样本（或分布外样本）的随机环境中进行顺序预测的问题。设计用于处理纯粹随机数据的算法往往在面对此类对抗样本时会失效，常常导致错误的预测。这在许多高风险应用中是不可取的，例如医疗建议，对手的预测避免误分类比做出预测更为可取。另一方面，假设完全对抗性数据会导致非常悲观的界，在实践中往往是空洞的。

为了捕捉这一动机，我们提出了一种新的顺序预测模型，介于纯粹随机和完全对抗性设置之间，允许学习者在对手样本上不作预测而不产生成本。我们假设可以访问非对抗样本的边缘分布，并设计了一个学习者的算法，其误差与假设类的VC维数（类似于随机设置）成比例，而不是Littlestone维数，后者表征了完全对抗性设置。此外，我们还为VC维数为1的类设计了一个学习者，即使没有访问边缘分布也能正常工作。我们的主要技术贡献是一种新型的度量不确定性的方法，用于学习VC类，这可能具有独立的研究价值。

[No.353] POP-3D: Open-Vocabulary 3D Occupancy Prediction from Images
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: POP-3D: 开放词汇量的图像三维占用预测
类别: 
作者: Antonín Vobecký;Oriane Siméoni;David Hurych;Spyros Gidaris;Andrei Bursuc;Patrick Perez;Josef Sivic;
机构: Valeo;Czech Technical University;
类型: Poster

arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.09413
英摘: We describe an approach to predict open-vocabulary 3D semantic voxel occupancy map from input 2D images with the objective of enabling 3D grounding, segmentation and retrieval of free-form language queries. This is a challenging problem because of the 2D-3D ambiguity and the open-vocabulary nature of the target tasks, where obtaining annotated training data in 3D is difficult. The contributions of this work are three-fold. First, we design a new model architecture for open-vocabulary 3D semantic occupancy prediction. The architecture consists of a 2D-3D encoder together with occupancy prediction and 3D-language heads. The output is a dense voxel map of 3D grounded language embeddings enabling a range of open-vocabulary tasks. Second, we develop a tri-modal self-supervised learning algorithm that leverages three modalities: (i) images, (ii) language and (iii) LiDAR point clouds, and enables training the proposed architecture using a strong pre-trained vision-language model without the need for any 3D manual language annotations. Finally, we demonstrate quantitatively the strengths of the proposed model on several open-vocabulary tasks: Zero-shot 3D semantic segmentation using existing datasets; 3D grounding and retrieval of free-form language queries, using a small dataset that we propose as an extension of nuScenes. You can find the project page here https://vobecant.github.io/POP3D.
中摘: 我们提出了一种从输入的2D图像预测开放词汇3D语义体素占用图的方法，旨在实现3D定位、分割和对自由形式语言查询的检索。这是一个具有挑战性的问题，原因在于2D-3D的歧义性和目标任务的开放词汇性质，在3D环境中获得标注训练数据非常困难。本文的工作贡献主要体现在三个方面。首先，我们设计了一种新的模型架构，用于开放词汇3D语义体素占用图预测。该架构由一个2D-3D编码器、体素预测头和3D语言头组成。输出是一个密集的3D体素地图，其中包含与3D语言嵌入相关的语义信息，能够支持一系列开放词汇任务。其次，我们开发了一种三模态自监督学习算法，利用了三种模态：（i）图像、（ii）语言和（iii）激光雷达点云，并且能够在没有3D手动语言注释的情况下，使用一个强大的预训练视觉-语言模型来训练所提出的架构。最后，我们在几个开放词汇任务上定量展示了所提模型的优势：使用现有数据集进行零样本3D语义分割；使用我们提议的一个扩展nuScenes的小型数据集，实现3D定位和对自由形式语言查询的检索。该项目页面可以在这里找到：https://vobecant.github.io/POP3D。

[No.355] ATMAN: Understanding Transformer Predictions Through Memory Efficient Attention Manipulation
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 阿特曼：通过高效注意力操作理解变压器预测
类别: 
作者: Björn Deiseroth;Mayukh Deb;Samuel Weinbach;Manuel Brack;Patrick Schramowski;Kristian Kersting;
机构: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham;Aleph Alpha;Adobe;Technische Universität Darmstadt;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/71776
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.08110
英摘: Generative transformer models have become increasingly complex, with large numbers of parameters and the ability to process multiple input modalities. Current methods for explaining their predictions are resource-intensive. Most crucially, they require prohibitively large amounts of extra memory, since they rely on backpropagation which allocates almost twice as much GPU memory as the forward pass. This makes it difficult, if not impossible, to use them in production. We present AtMan that provides explanations of generative transformer models at almost no extra cost. Specifically, AtMan is a modality-agnostic perturbation method that manipulates the attention mechanisms of transformers to produce relevance maps for the input with respect to the output prediction. Instead of using backpropagation, AtMan applies a parallelizable token-based search method based on cosine similarity neighborhood in the embedding space. Our exhaustive experiments on text and image-text benchmarks demonstrate that AtMan outperforms current state-of-the-art gradient-based methods on several metrics while being computationally efficient. As such, AtMan is suitable for use in large model inference deployments.
中摘: 生成式变压器模型变得日益复杂，拥有大量的参数，并能够处理多种输入模态。当前解释这些模型预测的方法资源密集型且成本高。最关键的是，它们需要大量额外的内存，因为它们依赖于反向传播，这几乎会分配两倍于前向传递的GPU内存。这使得在生产环境中使用它们变得困难，甚至不可能。我们提出了一种名为AtMan的方法，几乎不增加额外的成本就能提供生成式变压器模型的解释。具体而言，AtMan是一种模态无关的扰动方法，通过操纵变压器的注意力机制来生成与输出预测相关的输入重要性图。不同于使用反向传播，AtMan应用了一种基于嵌入空间余弦相似性邻域的并行化标记搜索方法。我们在文本和图像-文本基准上的详尽实验表明，AtMan在多个指标上优于现有的基于梯度的方法，并且计算效率更高。因此，AtMan适用于大规模模型推理部署。

[No.356] PAC-Bayes Generalization Certificates for Learned Inductive Conformal Prediction
来源: NeurIPS 2023
命中: predict
标题: 基于PAC-贝叶斯的一致性预测可信度证书学习推理
类别: 
作者: Apoorva Sharma;Sushant Veer;Asher Hancock;Heng Yang;Marco Pavone;Anirudha Majumdar;
机构: NVIDIA;Stanford University;Princeton University;
类型: Poster
链接: https://nips.cc/virtual/2023/poster/71506
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.04658
英摘: Inductive Conformal Prediction (ICP) provides a practical and effective approach for equipping deep learning models with uncertainty estimates in the form of set-valued predictions which are guaranteed to contain the ground truth with high probability. Despite the appeal of this coverage guarantee, these sets may not be efficient: the size and contents of the prediction sets are not directly controlled, and instead depend on the underlying model and choice of score function. To remedy this, recent work has proposed learning model and score function parameters using data to directly optimize the efficiency of the ICP prediction sets. While appealing, the generalization theory for such an approach is lacking: direct optimization of empirical efficiency may yield prediction sets that are either no longer efficient on test data, or no longer obtain the required coverage on test data. In this work, we use PAC-Bayes theory to obtain generalization bounds on both the coverage and the efficiency of set-valued predictors which can be directly optimized to maximize efficiency while satisfying a desired test coverage. In contrast to prior work, our framework allows us to utilize the entire calibration dataset to learn the parameters of the model and score function, instead of requiring a separate hold-out set for obtaining test-time coverage guarantees. We leverage these theoretical results to provide a practical algorithm for using calibration data to simultaneously fine-tune the parameters of a model and score function while guaranteeing test-time coverage and efficiency of the resulting prediction sets. We evaluate the approach on regression and classification tasks, and outperform baselines calibrated using a Hoeffding bound-based PAC guarantee on ICP, especially in the low-data regime.
中摘: 归纳自适应预测（Inductive Conformal Prediction, ICP）提供了一种实用且有效的方法，为深度学习模型添加以集合预测形式给出的不确定性估计，这些集合预测能够以高概率包含真实值。尽管这种覆盖保证具有吸引力，但这些集合可能不够高效：预测集合的大小和内容无法直接控制，而是依赖于基础模型和评分函数的选择。为了改进这一点，近期的研究提出使用数据来学习模型和评分函数参数，直接优化ICP预测集合的效率。虽然这种方法很有吸引力，但缺乏对其泛化理论的支持：直接优化经验效率可能会导致在测试数据上不再有效的预测集合，或者不再满足所需的覆盖概率。

在这项工作中，我们利用PAC-贝叶斯理论获得同时适用于覆盖和效率的泛化界，从而可以直接优化集合预测以最大化效率并满足所需的测试覆盖。与以往工作不同的是，我们的框架允许我们利用整个校准数据集来学习模型和评分函数的参数，而不是需要一个单独的保留集来获取测试时的覆盖保证。我们利用这些理论结果提供了一个实用算法，可以在使用校准数据的同时微调模型和评分函数的参数，同时确保测试时的覆盖和预测集合的效率。我们在回归和分类任务上评估了该方法，并在低数据量情况下，尤其是在ICP中，优于基于霍夫丁不等式PAC保证进行校准的基线方法。

arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.03704
英摘: Learning about the three-dimensional world from two-dimensional images is a fundamental problem in computer vision. An ideal neural network architecture for such tasks would leverage the fact that objects can be rotated and translated in three dimensions to make predictions about novel images. However, imposing SO(3)-equivariance on two-dimensional inputs is difficult because the group of three-dimensional rotations does not have a natural action on the two-dimensional plane. Specifically, it is possible that an element of SO(3) will rotate an image out of plane. We show that an algorithm that learns a three-dimensional representation of the world from two dimensional images must satisfy certain geometric consistency properties which we formulate as SO(2)-equivariance constraints. We use the induced and restricted representations of SO(2) on SO(3) to construct and classify architectures which satisfy these geometric consistency constraints. We prove that any architecture which respects said consistency constraints can be realized as an instance of our construction. We show that three previously proposed neural architectures for 3D pose prediction are special cases of our construction. We propose a new algorithm that is a learnable generalization of previously considered methods. We test our architecture on three pose predictions task and achieve SOTA results on both the PASCAL3D+ and SYMSOL pose estimation tasks.
中摘: 从二维图像学习三维世界是一个计算机视觉中的基本问题。理想的神经网络架构应该利用物体在三维空间中可以旋转和平移的事实，从而对新颖的图像做出预测。然而，对二维输入施加SO(3)-等变性是困难的，因为三维旋转群没有自然作用于二维平面的方式。具体来说，可能某个SO(3)的元素会将图像旋转出平面。我们证明了一个算法必须从二维图像学习三维世界的表示，必须满足某些几何一致性特性，我们将这些特性形式化为SO(2)-等变性约束。我们利用SO(2)在SO(3)上的诱导表示和限制表示来构建和分类满足这些几何一致性约束的架构。我们证明了任何尊重这些一致性约束的架构都可以作为我们构造的一个实例实现。我们展示了三种之前提出的三维姿态预测神经网络架构都是我们构造的特例。我们提出了一种新的算法，它是先前考虑方法的可学习泛化。我们在三个姿态预测任务上测试了我们的架构，并在PASCAL3D+和SYMSOL姿态估计任务上取得了最先进的结果。

英摘: Specifying reward signals that allow agents to learn complex behaviors is a long-standing challenge in reinforcement learning. A promising approach is to extract preferences for behaviors from unlabeled videos, which are widely available on the internet. We present Video Prediction Rewards (VIPER), an algorithm that leverages pretrained video prediction models as action-free reward signals for reinforcement learning. Specifically, we first train an autoregressive transformer on expert videos and then use the video prediction likelihoods as reward signals for a reinforcement learning agent. 英摘: In computational neuroscience, there has been an increased interest in developing machine learning algorithms that leverage brain imaging data to provide estimates of "brain age" for an individual. [No.365] Mixture Weight Estimation and Model Prediction in Multi-source Multi-target Domain Adaptation
来源: NeurIPS 2023

英摘: We consider the problem of learning a model from multiple heterogeneous sources with the goal of performing well on a new target distribution. The goal of learner is to mix these data sources in a target-distribution aware way and simultaneously minimize the empirical risk on the mixed source. The literature has made some tangible advancements in establishing theory of learning on mixture domain. However, there are still two unsolved problems. Firstly, how to estimate the optimal mixture of sources, given a target domain; Secondly, when there are numerous target domains, how to solve empirical risk minimization (ERM) for each target using possibly unique mixture of data sources in a computationally efficient manner. In this paper we address both problems efficiently and with guarantees. We cast the first problem, mixture weight estimation, as a convex-nonconcave compositional minimax problem, and propose an efficient stochastic algorithm with provable stationarity guarantees. Next, for the second problem, we identify that for certain regimes, solving ERM for each target domain individually can be avoided, and instead parameters for a target optimal model can be viewed as a non-linear function on a space of the mixture coefficients. Building upon this, we show that in the offline setting, a GD-trained overparameterized neural network can provably learn such function to predict the model of target domain instead of solving a designated ERM problem. Finally, we also consider an online setting and propose a label efficient online algorithm, which predicts parameters for new targets given an arbitrary sequence of mixing coefficients, while enjoying regret guarantees.

Once the representative tokens are determined, we proceed to merge other tokens into their closest representative token. Consequently, semantic similar tokens are merged together to form low-resolution regions, while semantic irrelevant tokens are preserved independently as high-resolution regions. This strategy effectively reduces the number of tokens, allowing subsequent layers to handle a reduced token sequence and achieve acceleration. We evaluate our proposed method on three different datasets and observe promising performance. For example, the "Segmenter ViT-L" model can be accelerated by 48% FPS without fine-tuning, while maintaining the performance. Additionally, our method can be applied to accelerate fine-tuning as well. Experimental results demonstrate that we can save 52% training time while accelerating 2.46 times FPS with only a 0.09% performance drop. The code is available at https://github.com/caddyless/ailurus/tree/main.
中摘: 视觉变换器（ViTs）因其出色的性能而成为视觉任务中的主流架构。然而，在处理长令牌序列时，特别是在需要高分辨率输入的密集预测任务中，ViTs 的复杂性显著增加。值得注意的是，密集预测任务，如语义分割或目标检测，更注重对象的轮廓或形状，而对象内部的纹理信息较少。受这一观察的启发，我们提出根据图像不同区域的重要性应用自适应分辨率。具体来说，在视觉变换器的中间层，我们利用一种空间感知的基于密度的聚类算法从令牌序列中选择代表令牌。一旦确定了代表令牌，我们将其余令牌合并到它们最近的代表令牌中。因此，具有语义相似性的令牌会被合并形成低分辨率区域，而语义无关的令牌则独立保留为高分辨率区域。这种策略有效减少了令牌的数量，使得后续层能够处理减少的令牌序列并实现加速。我们在三个不同的数据集上评估了我们提出的方法，并观察到了令人鼓舞的效果。例如，“Segmenter ViT-L”模型在无需微调的情况下可以加速48%，同时保持性能不变。此外，我们的方法还可以应用于加速微调。实验结果表明，与加速2.46倍FPS相比，我们仅损失0.09%的性能即可节省52%的训练时间。代码可在 https://github.com/caddyless/ailurus/tree/main 获取。

来源: NeurIPS 2023

英摘: Trajectory prediction plays a vital role in the performance of autonomous driving systems, and prediction accuracy, such as average displacement error (ADE) or final displacement error (FDE), is widely used as a performance metric. However, a significant disparity exists between the accuracy of predictors on fixed datasets and driving performance when the predictors are used downstream for vehicle control, because of a dynamics gap. In the real world, the prediction algorithm influences the behavior of the ego vehicle, which, in turn, influences the behaviors of other vehicles nearby. This interaction results in predictor-specific dynamics that directly impacts prediction results. In fixed datasets, since other vehicles' responses are predetermined, this interaction effect is lost, leading to a significant dynamics gap. This paper studies the overlooked significance of this dynamics gap. We also examine several other factors contributing to the disparity between prediction performance and driving performance. The findings highlight the trade-off between the predictor's computational efficiency and prediction accuracy in determining real-world driving performance. In summary, an interactive, task-driven evaluation protocol for trajectory prediction is crucial to capture its effectiveness for autonomous driving. Source code along with experimental settings is available online.
中摘: 轨迹预测在自动驾驶系统的表现中扮演着至关重要的角色，而预测准确性，如平均位移误差（ADE）或最终位移误差（FDE），广泛用作性能指标。然而，当预测器在下游用于车辆控制时，在固定数据集上的预测准确性和实际驾驶表现之间存在显著差异，这是因为存在动态差距。在现实世界中，预测算法会影响ego车辆的行为，进而影响附近其他车辆的行为。这种交互作用导致了预测器特有的动态特性，直接影响预测结果。在固定数据集中，由于其他车辆的响应已经被预设，这种交互效应被丢失，从而导致了显著的动态差距。本文研究了这一动态差距被忽视的重要性，并探讨了其他导致预测性能与驾驶性能之间差异的因素。研究发现突显了预测器的计算效率与预测准确性之间的权衡如何决定实际驾驶性能。总之，一个互动的任务驱动评估协议对于捕捉轨迹预测在自动驾驶中的有效性至关重要。相关源代码及实验设置已在线提供。

[No.376] Rethinking the generalization of drug target affinity prediction algorithms via similarity aware evaluation
来源: ICLR 2025

标题: 通过相似性意识评价重新思考药物靶标亲和力预测算法的一般化
