[No.1062] AIO-P: Expanding Neural Performance Predictors beyond Image Classification
来源: AAAI 2023
命中: predict
标题: AIO-P：将神经性能预测扩展到图像分类之外
类别: machine learning iii
作者: Keith G. Mills;Di Niu;Mohammad Salameh;Weichen Qiu;Fred X. Han;Puyuan Liu;Jialin Zhang;Wei Lu;Shangling Jui;
机构: University of Alberta;Huawei;
类型: Technical
链接: https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/26101
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.17228
英摘: Evaluating neural network performance is critical to deep neural network design but a costly procedure. Neural predictors provide an efficient solution by treating architectures as samples and learning to estimate their performance on a given task. However, existing predictors are task-dependent, predominantly estimating neural network performance on image classification benchmarks. They are also search-space dependent; each predictor is designed to make predictions for a specific architecture search space with predefined topologies and set of operations. In this paper, we propose a novel All-in-One Predictor (AIO-P), which aims to pretrain neural predictors on architecture examples from multiple, separate computer vision (CV) task domains and multiple architecture spaces, and then transfer to unseen downstream CV tasks or neural architectures. We describe our proposed techniques for general graph representation, efficient predictor pretraining and knowledge infusion techniques, as well as methods to transfer to downstream tasks/spaces. Extensive experimental results show that AIO-P can achieve Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and Spearman's Rank Correlation (SRCC) below 1% and above 0.5, respectively, on a breadth of target downstream CV tasks with or without fine-tuning, outperforming a number of baselines. Moreover, AIO-P can directly transfer to new architectures not seen during training, accurately rank them and serve as an effective performance estimator when paired with an algorithm designed to preserve performance while reducing FLOPs.
中摘: 评估神经网络性能对于深度神经网络设计至关重要，但这一过程代价高昂。神经预测器通过将架构视为样本并学习估计其在特定任务上的性能来提供一个高效解决方案。然而，现有的预测器主要依赖于特定任务，大多用于估计神经网络在图像分类基准上的性能。它们还依赖于搜索空间；每个预测器都是为特定的架构搜索空间设计的，该空间具有预定义的拓扑结构和操作集。在本文中，我们提出了一种名为“全功能预测器”（AIO-P）的新颖方法，旨在预先训练神经预测器在多个独立的计算机视觉（CV）任务领域和多种架构空间中的示例上，然后转移到未见过的下游CV任务或神经架构上。我们描述了我们提出的通用图表示技术、高效的预测器预训练技术和知识注入技术，以及将预测器转移到下游任务/空间的方法。广泛的实验结果显示，AIO-P可以在不需要微调的情况下，在多种目标下游CV任务上分别实现小于1%的平均绝对误差（MAE）和大于0.5的斯皮尔曼等级相关系数（SRCC），并且在某些基准上优于多个基线模型。此外，AIO-P可以直接转移到在训练过程中未见过的新架构上，准确地对这些架构进行排名，并且当与一个旨在保持性能同时减少FLOPs的算法配对时，可以作为一个有效的性能估算器使用。

[No.1064] Contrastive Predictive Autoencoders for Dynamic Point Cloud Self-Supervised Learning
来源: AAAI 2023
命中: predict
标题: 动态点云自监督学习的对比预测自动编码器
类别: machine learning iii
作者: Xiaoxiao Sheng;Zhiqiang Shen;Gang Xiao;
机构: Shanghai Jiao Tong University;
类型: Technical
链接: https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/26170
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.12959
英摘: We present a new self-supervised paradigm on point cloud sequence understanding. Inspired by the discriminative and generative self-supervised methods, we design two tasks, namely point cloud sequence based Contrastive Prediction and Reconstruction (CPR), to collaboratively learn more comprehensive spatiotemporal representations. Specifically, dense point cloud segments are first input into an encoder to extract embeddings. All but the last ones are then aggregated by a context-aware autoregressor to make predictions for the last target segment. Towards the goal of modeling multi-granularity structures, local and global contrastive learning are performed between predictions and targets. To further improve the generalization of representations, the predictions are also utilized to reconstruct raw point cloud sequences by a decoder, where point cloud colorization is employed to discriminate against different frames. By combining classic contrast and reconstruction paradigms, it makes the learned representations with both global discrimination and local perception. We conduct experiments on four point cloud sequence benchmarks, and report the results on action recognition and gesture recognition under multiple experimental settings. The performances are comparable with supervised methods and show powerful transferability.
中摘: 我们提出了一种新的自监督点云序列理解范式。受判别性和生成性自监督方法的启发，我们设计了两个任务，即基于点云序列的对比预测与重建（CPR），以协作学习更全面的空间-时间表示。具体而言，密集的点云片段首先输入编码器以提取嵌入。除了最后一个片段外，其余片段通过上下文感知的自回归模型进行聚合，以预测最后一个目标片段。为了建模多粒度结构，我们在预测与目标之间进行了局部和全局对比学习。为了进一步提高表示的一般化能力，预测还被用于通过解码器重建原始点云序列，其中点云着色用于区分不同的帧。通过结合经典的对比和重建范式，使学习到的表示既具有全局辨别力又具有局部感知能力。我们在四个点云序列基准上进行了实验，并在多种实验设置下报告了动作识别和手势识别的结果。这些性能与监督方法相当，并显示出强大的迁移能力。

[No.1065] Forecasting with Sparse but Informative Variables: A Case Study in Predicting Blood Glucose
来源: AAAI 2023
命中: predict
标题: 基于稀疏但信息丰富的变量进行预测：一项关于预测血糖水平的研究案例
类别: machine learning iii
作者: Harry Rubin-Falcone;Joyce Lee;Jenna Wiens;
机构: University of Michigan;
类型: Technical
链接: https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/26154
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2304.08593
英摘: In time-series forecasting, future target values may be affected by both intrinsic and extrinsic effects. When forecasting blood glucose, for example, intrinsic effects can be inferred from the history of the target signal alone (\textit{i.e.} blood glucose), but accurately modeling the impact of extrinsic effects requires auxiliary signals, like the amount of carbohydrates ingested. Standard forecasting techniques often assume that extrinsic and intrinsic effects vary at similar rates. However, when auxiliary signals are generated at a much lower frequency than the target variable (e.g., blood glucose measurements are made every 5 minutes, while meals occur once every few hours), even well-known extrinsic effects (e.g., carbohydrates increase blood glucose) may prove difficult to learn. To better utilize these \textit{sparse but informative variables} (SIVs), we introduce a novel encoder/decoder forecasting approach that accurately learns the per-timepoint effect of the SIV, by (i) isolating it from intrinsic effects and (ii) restricting its learned effect based on domain knowledge. On a simulated dataset pertaining to the task of blood glucose forecasting, when the SIV is accurately recorded our approach outperforms baseline approaches in terms of rMSE (13.07 [95% CI: 11.77,14.16] vs. 14.14 [12.69,15.27]). In the presence of a corrupted SIV, the proposed approach can still result in lower error compared to the baseline but the advantage is reduced as noise increases. By isolating their effects and incorporating domain knowledge, our approach makes it possible to better utilize SIVs in forecasting.
中摘: 在时间序列预测中，未来的目标值可能受到内在和外在效应的影响。例如，在预测血糖时，内在效应可以从目标信号的历史数据（即血糖）中推断出来，但准确建模外在效应的影响则需要辅助信号，比如摄入的碳水化合物数量。标准的预测技术通常假设外在和内在效应以相似的速度变化。然而，当辅助信号的生成频率远低于目标变量（例如，血糖测量每5分钟进行一次，而进餐则每几小时发生一次）时，即使是众所周知的外在效应（例如，碳水化合物增加血糖），也可能会难以学习。为了更好地利用这些“稀疏但信息丰富的变量”（SIVs），我们提出了一种新颖的编码器/解码器预测方法，该方法通过（i）将它们从内在效应中分离出来，以及（ii）基于领域知识限制它们的学习效应，能够精确地学习每个时间点的SIV效应。在与血糖预测任务相关的模拟数据集上，当SIV被准确记录时，我们的方法在rMSE方面优于基线方法（13.07 [95% CI: 11.77,14.16] vs. 14.14 [12.69,15.27]）。在SIV受到污染的情况下，所提出的方法仍然可以比基线方法产生更低的误差，但随着噪声的增加，这种优势会减弱。通过分离它们的效果并结合领域知识，我们的方法使得在预测中更好地利用SIV成为可能。

[No.1067] Provable Detection of Propagating Sampling Bias in Prediction Models
来源: AAAI 2023
命中: predict
标题: 可验证检测传播采样偏差的预测模型
类别: machine learning iii
作者: Pavan Ravishankar;Qingyu Mo;Edward McFowland III;Daniel B. Neill;
机构: New York University;Harvard University;
类型: Technical
链接: https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/26144
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.06752
英摘: With an increased focus on incorporating fairness in machine learning models, it becomes imperative not only to assess and mitigate bias at each stage of the machine learning pipeline but also to understand the downstream impacts of bias across stages. Here we consider a general, but realistic, scenario in which a predictive model is learned from (potentially biased) training data, and model predictions are assessed post-hoc for fairness by some auditing method. We provide a theoretical analysis of how a specific form of data bias, differential sampling bias, propagates from the data stage to the prediction stage. Unlike prior work, we evaluate the downstream impacts of data biases quantitatively rather than qualitatively and prove theoretical guarantees for detection. Under reasonable assumptions, we quantify how the amount of bias in the model predictions varies as a function of the amount of differential sampling bias in the data, and at what point this bias becomes provably detectable by the auditor. Through experiments on two criminal justice datasets -- the well-known COMPAS dataset and historical data from NYPD's stop and frisk policy -- we demonstrate that the theoretical results hold in practice even when our assumptions are relaxed.
中摘: 随着对在机器学习模型中融入公平性的关注增加，不仅在机器学习管道的每个阶段评估和缓解偏见变得至关重要，还需要理解偏见在各个阶段的下游影响。在这里，我们考虑一个一般但现实的情景：从（可能带有偏见的）训练数据中学习预测模型，并通过某种审计方法事后评估模型预测的公平性。我们对一种特定形式的数据偏见——差异性采样偏见——如何从数据阶段传播到预测阶段进行了理论分析。与以往工作不同的是，我们定量而非定性地评估数据偏见的下游影响，并证明了检测方面的理论保证。在合理假设下，我们量化了模型预测中的偏见量如何随数据差异性采样偏见量的变化而变化，并确定了审计者能够证明检测到这种偏见的临界点。通过对两个刑事司法数据集——著名的COMPAS数据集和纽约市警察局（NYPD）的“停车和搜身”政策的历史数据——进行实验，我们展示了即使在放松假设的情况下，理论结果在实践中也仍然成立。

[No.1068] Sharing Pattern Submodels for Prediction with Missing Values
来源: AAAI 2023
命中: predict
标题: 基于共享模式子模型的缺失值预测方法
类别: machine learning iii
作者: Lena Stempfle;Ashkan Panahi;Fredrik D. Johansson;
机构: Chalmers University of Technology;
类型: Technical
链接: https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/26179
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.11161
英摘: Missing values are unavoidable in many applications of machine learning and present challenges both during training and at test time. When variables are missing in recurring patterns, fitting separate pattern submodels have been proposed as a solution. However, fitting models independently does not make efficient use of all available data. Conversely, fitting a single shared model to the full data set relies on imputation which often leads to biased results when missingness depends on unobserved factors. We propose an alternative approach, called sharing pattern submodels, which i) makes predictions that are robust to missing values at test time, ii) maintains or improves the predictive power of pattern submodels, and iii) has a short description, enabling improved interpretability. Parameter sharing is enforced through sparsity-inducing regularization which we prove leads to consistent estimation. Finally, we give conditions for when a sharing model is optimal, even when both missingness and the target outcome depend on unobserved variables. Classification and regression experiments on synthetic and real-world data sets demonstrate that our models achieve a favorable tradeoff between pattern specialization and information sharing.

来源: AAAI 2023

标题: 模型作为代理：在基于模型的多agent reinforcement learning中优化交互式局部模型的多步预测

英摘: Research in model-based reinforcement learning has made significant progress in recent years. Compared to single-agent settings, the exponential dimension growth of the joint state-action space in multi-agent systems dramatically increases the complexity of the environment dynamics, which makes it infeasible to learn an accurate global model and thus necessitates the use of agent-wise local models. However, during multi-step model rollouts, the prediction of one local model can affect the predictions of other local models in the next step. As a result, local prediction errors can be propagated to other localities and eventually give rise to considerably large global errors. Furthermore, since the models are generally used to predict for multiple steps, simply minimizing one-step prediction errors regardless of their long-term effect on other models may further aggravate the propagation of local errors. To this end, we propose Models as AGents (MAG), a multi-agent model optimization framework that reversely treats the local models as multi-step decision making agents and the current policies as the dynamics during the model rollout process. In this way, the local models are able to consider the multi-step mutual affect between each other before making predictions. Theoretically, we show that the objective of MAG is approximately equivalent to maximizing a lower bound of the true environment return. Experiments on the challenging StarCraft II benchmark demonstrate the effectiveness of MAG.
中摘: 基于模型的强化学习研究在近年来取得了显著进展。与单智能体设置相比，多智能体系统中的联合状态-动作空间维度呈指数级增长，极大地增加了环境动力学的复杂性，使得学习准确的全局模型变得不可行，因此需要使用智能体级别的局部模型。然而，在多步模型展开过程中，一个局部模型的预测可能会影响其他局部模型在下一阶段的预测。因此，局部预测误差可以传播到其他区域，并最终导致相当大的全局误差。此外，由于这些模型通常用于多步预测，仅仅为了最小化一步预测误差而不考虑其对其他模型的长期影响可能会进一步加剧局部误差的传播。为此，我们提出了一种名为“Models as Agents”（MAG）的多智能体模型优化框架，该框架将局部模型逆向地视为多步决策制定智能体，而当前策略则被视为模型展开过程中的动力学。通过这种方式，局部模型能够在进行预测之前考虑彼此之间的多步相互影响。理论上，我们证明了MAG的目标大约等同于最大化真实环境回报的一个下界。在具有挑战性的StarCraft II基准测试上的实验表明了MAG的有效性。

Given multiple models that perform almost equally well for a prediction task, to what extent do predictions vary across these models? If predictions are relatively consistent for similar models, then the standard approach of choosing the model that optimizes a penalized loss suffices. But what if predictions vary significantly for similar models? In machine learning, this is referred to as predictive multiplicity i.e. the prevalence of conflicting predictions assigned by near-optimal competing models. In this paper, we present a framework for measuring predictive multiplicity in probabilistic classification (predicting the probability of a positive outcome). We introduce measures that capture the variation in risk estimates over the set of competing models, and develop optimization-based methods to compute these measures efficiently and reliably for convex empirical risk minimization problems. We demonstrate the incidence and prevalence of predictive multiplicity in real-world tasks. Further, we provide insight into how predictive multiplicity arises by analyzing the relationship between predictive multiplicity and data set characteristics (outliers, separability, and majority-minority structure). Our results emphasize the need to report predictive multiplicity more widely.

来源: AAAI 2023

作者: Fangqi Zhu;Jun Gao;Changlong Yu;Wei Wang;Chen Xu;Xin Mu;Min Yang;Ruifeng Xu;

英摘: Script event prediction aims to predict the subsequent event given the context. This requires the capability to infer the correlations between events. Recent works have attempted to improve event correlation reasoning by using pretrained language models and incorporating external knowledge~(e.g., discourse relations). Though promising results have been achieved, some challenges still remain. First, the pretrained language models adopted by current works ignore event-level knowledge, resulting in an inability to capture the correlations between events well. Second, modeling correlations between events with discourse relations is limited because it can only capture explicit correlations between events with discourse markers, and cannot capture many implicit correlations. To this end, we propose a novel generative approach for this task, in which a pretrained language model is fine-tuned with an event-centric pretraining objective and predicts the next event within a generative paradigm. Specifically, we first introduce a novel event-level blank infilling strategy as the learning objective to inject event-level knowledge into the pretrained language model, and then design a likelihood-based contrastive loss for fine-tuning the generative model. Instead of using an additional prediction layer, we perform prediction by using sequence likelihoods generated by the generative model. Our approach models correlations between events in a soft way without any external knowledge. The likelihood-based prediction eliminates the need to use additional networks to make predictions and is somewhat interpretable since it scores each word in the event. Experimental results on the multi-choice narrative cloze~(MCNC) task demonstrate that our approach achieves better results than other state-of-the-art baselines. 中摘: 事件预测旨在根据上下文预测后续事件。这需要推断事件之间的关联能力。近期的研究试图通过使用预训练语言模型并结合外部知识（例如，话语关系）来提高事件关联推理的能力。尽管取得了令人鼓舞的结果，但仍存在一些挑战。首先，当前研究采用的预训练语言模型忽略了事件级别的知识，导致无法很好地捕捉事件之间的关联。其次，使用话语关系建模事件之间的关联受到限制，因为它只能捕捉带有话语标记的显式关联，而无法捕捉许多隐式关联。为此，我们提出了一种新的生成方法来解决这一任务，在该方法中，预训练语言模型通过以事件为中心的预训练目标进行微调，并在生成范式中预测下一个事件。具体而言，我们首先引入了一种新颖的事件级别空白填充策略作为学习目标，以将事件级别的知识注入预训练语言模型，然后设计了一种基于似然性的对比损失来微调生成模型。我们不使用额外的预测层，而是通过生成模型产生的序列似然性来进行预测。我们的方法以软方式建模事件之间的关联，无需使用任何外部知识。基于似然性的预测消除了需要使用额外网络来进行预测的需求，并且由于它为每个事件中的单词评分，因此具有一定的可解释性。在多选择叙述填补（MCNC）任务上的实验结果表明，我们的方法优于其他最先进的基线方法。我们的代码将在https://github.com/zhufq00/mcnc上公开。

英摘: Script is a kind of structured knowledge extracted from texts, which contains a sequence of events. Based on such knowledge, script event prediction aims to predict the subsequent event. To do so, two aspects should be considered for events, namely, event description (i.e., what the events should contain) and event encoding (i.e., how they should be encoded). Most existing methods describe an event by a verb together with only a few core arguments (i.e., subject, object, and indirect object), which are not precise. In addition, existing event encoders are limited to a fixed number of arguments, which are not flexible to deal with extra information. Fundamentally, it is based on the proposed rich event description, which enriches the existing ones with three kinds of important information, namely, the senses of verbs, extra semantic roles, and types of participants. REP contains an event extractor to extract such information from texts. Based on the extracted rich information, a predictor then selects the most probable subsequent event. The core component of the predictor is a transformer-based event encoder to flexibly deal with an arbitrary number of arguments. Experimental results on the widely used Gigaword Corpus show the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

[No.1085] G2LTraj: A Global-to-Local Generation Approach for Trajectory Prediction
来源: IJCAI 2024
命中: predict
标题: G2LTraj：一种全局到局部生成方法用于轨迹预测
类别: Data Mining
作者: Zhanwei Zhang;Zishuo Hua;Minghao Chen;Wei Lu;Binbin Lin;Deng Cai;Wenxiao Wang;
机构: Zhejiang University;Hangzhou Dianzi University;Ningbo Beilun Third Container Terminal Co., Ltd;Zhiyuan Research Institute;

arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.19330
英摘: Predicting future trajectories of traffic agents accurately holds substantial importance in various applications such as autonomous driving. Previous methods commonly infer all future steps of an agent either recursively or simultaneously. However, the recursive strategy suffers from the accumulated error, while the simultaneous strategy overlooks the constraints among future steps, resulting in kinematically infeasible predictions. To address these issues, in this paper, we propose G2LTraj, a plug-and-play global-to-local generation approach for trajectory prediction. Specifically, we generate a series of global key steps that uniformly cover the entire future time range. Subsequently, the local intermediate steps between the adjacent key steps are recursively filled in. In this way, we prevent the accumulated error from propagating beyond the adjacent key steps. Moreover, to boost the kinematical feasibility, we not only introduce the spatial constraints among key steps but also strengthen the temporal constraints among the intermediate steps. Finally, to ensure the optimal granularity of key steps, we design a selectable granularity strategy that caters to each predicted trajectory. Our G2LTraj significantly improves the performance of seven existing trajectory predictors across the ETH, UCY and nuScenes datasets. Experimental results demonstrate its effectiveness. Code will be available at https://github.com/Zhanwei-Z/G2LTraj.
中摘: 准确预测交通代理未来的轨迹在自动驾驶等众多应用中具有重要意义。以往的方法通常通过递归或同时的方式推断所有未来步骤。然而，递归策略会导致累积误差，而同时策略则忽视了未来步骤之间的约束，从而产生动态上不可行的预测。为了解决这些问题，本文提出了一种名为G2LTraj的即插即用全局到局部生成方法，用于轨迹预测。具体而言，我们生成一系列均匀覆盖整个未来时间范围的全局关键步骤。随后，在相邻的关键步骤之间递归填充局部中间步骤。这样可以防止累积误差传播到相邻的关键步骤之外。此外，为了提高动态可行性，我们不仅引入了关键步骤之间的空间约束，还增强了中间步骤之间的临时约束。最后，为了确保关键步骤的最佳粒度，我们设计了一种可选择的粒度策略，以适应每个预测的轨迹。我们的G2LTraj在ETH、UCY和nuScenes数据集上显著提高了七个现有轨迹预测器的性能，并且实验结果证明了其有效性。代码将发布在https://github.com/Zhanwei-Z/G2LTraj。

中摘: 神经预测器在提升神经架构搜索（NAS）中的耗时性能评估阶段方面非常有效，因为它们可以直接估计未见过的架构。尽管效果显著，但使用较少标注架构进行强大神经预测器的训练仍然是一个巨大的挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于架构上下文信息的上下文感知神经预测器（CAP），它只需要少量标注架构即可进行训练。具体而言，输入架构被编码为图，并且预测器推断每个图内部节点周围的上下文结构。通过提出的上下文感知自监督任务增强后，预训练的预测器可以获得具有表现力和泛化能力的架构表示。因此，只需少量标注架构即可完成训练。在不同的搜索空间中进行的实验结果表明，CAP 在与最先进的神经预测器相比时表现出更优越的性能。特别是在 NAS-Bench-101 中，CAP 只需 172 个标注架构即可精确排名架构。此外，CAP 还能在 CIFAR-10 数据集上的 NAS-Bench-101 和 DARTS 搜索空间中帮助找到有潜力的架构，作为 NAS 探索搜索空间的有效导航工具。

[No.1093] PACIA: Parameter-Efficient Adapter for Few-Shot Molecular Property Prediction
来源: IJCAI 2024
命中: predict
标题: PACIA：参数高效适配器用于少样本分子性质预测
类别: Machine Learning
作者: Shiguang Wu;Yaqing Wang;Quanming Yao;
机构: Tsinghua University;Baidu;
类型: Poster
链接: https://www.ijcai.org/proceedings/2024/576
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.00614
英摘: Molecular property prediction (MPP) plays a crucial role in biomedical applications, but it often encounters challenges due to a scarcity of labeled data. Existing works commonly adopt gradient-based strategy to update a large amount of parameters for task-level adaptation. However, the increase of adaptive parameters can lead to overfitting and poor performance. Observing that graph neural network (GNN) performs well as both encoder and predictor, we propose PACIA, a parameter-efficient GNN adapter for few-shot MPP. We design a unified adapter to generate a few adaptive parameters to modulate the message passing process of GNN. We then adopt a hierarchical adaptation mechanism to adapt the encoder at task-level and the predictor at query-level by the unified GNN adapter. Extensive results show that PACIA obtains the state-of-the-art performance in few-shot MPP problems, and our proposed hierarchical adaptation mechanism is rational and effective.
中摘: 分子属性预测（MPP）在生物医学应用中发挥着重要作用，但由于标记数据稀缺常常会遇到挑战。现有工作通常采用基于梯度的方法来更新大量参数以实现任务级别的适应。然而，适应参数的增加可能导致过拟合和性能不佳。观察到图神经网络（GNN）在编码器和预测器两个方面都表现良好，我们提出了一种参数高效的GNN适配器PACIA，用于解决少样本的MPP问题。我们设计了一个统一的适配器来生成少量的适应参数以调节GNN的消息传递过程。然后，我们采用分层适应机制，在任务级别适配编码器，在查询级别适配预测器，通过统一的GNN适配器实现这一目标。广泛的实验结果表明，PACIA在少样本MPP问题上获得了最先进的性能，并且我们提出的分层适应机制是合理且有效的。

[No.1095] Predictive Accuracy-Based Active Learning for Medical Image Segmentation
来源: IJCAI 2024
命中: predict
标题: 基于预测准确性的主动学习在医学图像分割中的应用
类别: Machine Learning
作者: Jun Shi;Shulan Ruan;Ziqi Zhu;Minfan Zhao;Hong An;Xudong Xue;Bing Yan;
机构: University of Science and Technology of China;Laoshan Laboratory;Huazhong University of Science and Technology;
类型: Poster
链接: https://www.ijcai.org/proceedings/2024/540
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2405.00452
英摘: Active learning is considered a viable solution to alleviate the contradiction between the high dependency of deep learning-based segmentation methods on annotated data and the expensive pixel-level annotation cost of medical images. However, most existing methods suffer from unreliable uncertainty assessment and the struggle to balance diversity and informativeness, leading to poor performance in segmentation tasks. In response, we propose an efficient Predictive Accuracy-based Active Learning (PAAL) method for medical image segmentation, first introducing predictive accuracy to define uncertainty. Specifically, PAAL mainly consists of an Accuracy Predictor (AP) and a Weighted Polling Strategy (WPS). The former is an attached learnable module that can accurately predict the segmentation accuracy of unlabeled samples relative to the target model with the predicted posterior probability. The latter provides an efficient hybrid querying scheme by combining predicted accuracy and feature representation, aiming to ensure the uncertainty and diversity of the acquired samples. Extensive experiment results on multiple datasets demonstrate the superiority of PAAL. PAAL achieves comparable accuracy to fully annotated data while reducing annotation costs by approximately 50% to 80%, showcasing significant potential in clinical applications. The code is available at https://github.com/shijun18/PAAL-MedSeg.
中摘: 主动学习被认为是一种缓解基于深度学习的分割方法对标注数据的高度依赖与医学图像逐像素标注成本昂贵之间矛盾的有效解决方案。然而，现有大多数方法在不确定性评估方面不可靠，并且难以平衡多样性和信息量，导致分割任务性能不佳。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种高效的预测准确度为基础的主动学习（PAAL）方法用于医学图像分割，首先引入预测准确度来定义不确定性。具体而言，PAAL主要由准确度预测器（AP）和加权投票策略（WPS）组成。前者是一个附加的可学习模块，能够通过预测后验概率准确预测未标注样本相对于目标模型的分割准确度。后者提供了一种高效的混合查询方案，结合预测准确度和特征表示，旨在确保获取样本的不确定性和多样性。在多个数据集上的广泛实验结果表明，PAAL具有明显优势。PAAL在减少约50%至80%的标注成本的同时，实现了与完全标注数据相当的准确性，展示了其在临床应用中的巨大潜力。代码可在https://github.com/shijun18/PAAL-MedSeg获取。

[No.1192] Single Sequence Prediction over Reasoning Graphs for Multi-hop QA
来源: ACL 2023
命中: predict
标题: 基于推理图的多跳问答单序列预测
类别: 
作者: Gowtham Ramesh;Makesh Narsimhan Sreedhar;Junjie Hu;
机构: University of Wisconsin-Madison;
类型: Long
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.642/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.00335
英摘: Recent generative approaches for multi-hop question answering (QA) utilize the fusion-in-decoder method~\cite{izacard-grave-2021-leveraging} to generate a single sequence output which includes both a final answer and a reasoning path taken to arrive at that answer, such as passage titles and key facts from those passages. While such models can lead to better interpretability and high quantitative scores, they often have difficulty accurately identifying the passages corresponding to key entities in the context, resulting in incorrect passage hops and a lack of faithfulness in the reasoning path. To address this, we propose a single-sequence prediction method over a local reasoning graph (\model)\footnote{Code/Models will be released at \url{https://github.com/gowtham1997/SeqGraph}} that integrates a graph structure connecting key entities in each context passage to relevant subsequent passages for each question. We use a graph neural network to encode this graph structure and fuse the resulting representations into the entity representations of the model. Our experiments show significant improvements in answer exact-match/F1 scores and faithfulness of grounding in the reasoning path on the HotpotQA dataset and achieve state-of-the-art numbers on the Musique dataset with only up to a 4\% increase in model parameters.
中摘: 最近的多跳问答（QA）生成方法利用融合在解码器中的方法~\cite{izacard-grave-2021-leveraging}生成一个包含最终答案和推理路径的单一序列输出，这些推理路径可能包括来自各段落的段落标题和关键事实。虽然这样的模型可以提高可解释性和定量评分，但它们往往难以准确识别与上下文中的关键实体对应的段落，导致推理路径中的不正确的段落跳转，并且缺乏忠实性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种基于局部推理图的单一序列预测方法（\model），该方法将连接每个上下文段落中的关键实体与其相关后续段落的图结构整合起来，用于每个问题。我们使用图神经网络来编码这种图结构，并将生成的表示融合到模型的关键实体表示中。我们的实验结果显示，在HotpotQA数据集上显著提高了答案的精确匹配/F1分数，并且在推理路径中的忠实性方面也有所提升；同时，在Musique数据集上达到了最先进的数值表现，仅增加了不到4%的模型参数量。

[No.1193] SPEECH: Structured Prediction with Energy-Based Event-Centric Hyperspheres
来源: ACL 2023

机构: National University of Singapore;Zhejiang University;
类型: Long
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.21/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.13617
英摘: Event-centric structured prediction involves predicting structured outputs of events. To address these issues, we propose Structured Prediction with Energy-based Event-Centric Hyperspheres (SPEECH). 中摘: 事件中心的结构化预测涉及预测事件的结构化输出。在大多数自然语言处理（NLP）情况下，事件结构复杂且具有多重依赖关系，有效表示这些复杂的结构化事件颇具挑战性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了基于能量模型的事件中心结构化超球面预测（SPEECH）。SPEECH 使用能量模型来表示事件结构组件之间的复杂依赖关系，并用简单的但有效的超球面来表示事件类别。在两个统一标注的事件数据集上的实验表明，SPEECH 在事件检测和事件关系提取任务中表现优异。

[No.1194] Token-wise Decomposition of Autoregressive Language Model Hidden States for Analyzing Model Predictions
来源: ACL 2023
命中: predict
标题: 基于令牌的自回归语言模型隐藏状态分解以分析模型预测
类别: 
作者: Byung-Doh Oh;William Schuler;
机构: Ohio State University;
类型: Long
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-long.562/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2305.10614
英摘: While there is much recent interest in studying why Transformer-based large language models make predictions the way they do, the complex computations performed within each layer have made their behavior somewhat opaque. To mitigate this opacity, this work presents a linear decomposition of final hidden states from autoregressive language models based on each initial input token, which is exact for virtually all contemporary Transformer architectures. This decomposition allows the definition of probability distributions that ablate the contribution of specific input tokens, which can be used to analyze their influence on model probabilities over a sequence of upcoming words with only one forward pass from the model. Using the change in next-word probability as a measure of importance, this work first examines which context words make the biggest contribution to language model predictions. Regression experiments suggest that Transformer-based language models rely primarily on collocational associations, followed by linguistic factors such as syntactic dependencies and coreference relationships in making next-word predictions. Additionally, analyses using these measures to predict syntactic dependencies and coreferent mention spans show that collocational association and repetitions of the same token largely explain the language models' predictions on these tasks.
中摘: 尽管最近对基于Transformer的大语言模型为何做出特定预测产生了浓厚兴趣，但每层内部进行的复杂计算使得它们的行为变得有些不透明。为了缓解这种不透明性，这项工作提出了一个基于每个初始输入词的自回归语言模型最终隐藏状态的线性分解方法，这种方法几乎适用于所有现代Transformer架构。这种分解允许定义概率分布，以消除特定输入词的贡献，从而仅通过一次从模型的前向传递就可以分析这些词对序列中后续单词模型概率的影响。使用下一词概率的变化作为重要性的衡量标准，这项工作首先研究了哪些上下文词对语言模型预测做出了最大的贡献。回归实验表明，基于Transformer的语言模型主要依赖于共现关联，其次是诸如句法依赖关系和指代关系等语言因素来进行下一词预测。此外，使用这些度量来预测句法依赖关系和共指提及范围的分析显示，共现关联和相同词的重复使用主要解释了语言模型在这类任务上的预测。

[No.1195] Towards Building a Robust Toxicity Predictor
来源: ACL 2023
命中: predict
标题: 构建稳健的毒性预测器
类别: 
作者: Dmitriy Bespalov;Sourav Bhabesh;Yi Xiang;Liutong Zhou;Yanjun Qi;
机构: Amazon;
类型: Industry
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.acl-industry.56/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.08690
英摘: Recent NLP literature pays little attention to the robustness of toxicity language predictors, while these systems are most likely to be used in adversarial contexts. This paper presents a novel adversarial attack, \texttt{ToxicTrap}, introducing small word-level perturbations to fool SOTA text classifiers to predict toxic text samples as benign. ToxicTrap exploits greedy based search strategies to enable fast and effective generation of toxic adversarial examples. Two novel goal function designs allow ToxicTrap to identify weaknesses in both multiclass and multilabel toxic language detectors. Our empirical results show that SOTA toxicity text classifiers are indeed vulnerable to the proposed attacks, attaining over 98\% attack success rates in multilabel cases. We also show how a vanilla adversarial training and its improved version can help increase robustness of a toxicity detector even against unseen attacks.
中摘: 近年来，自然语言处理（NLP）文献很少关注毒性语言预测器的鲁棒性，而这些系统最有可能在对抗性环境中被使用。本文介绍了一种新颖的对抗攻击方法——\texttt{ToxicTrap}，通过引入微小的词级扰动来欺骗当前最先进的文本分类器，使其将有毒文本样本误判为良性。ToxicTrap 利用贪婪基搜索策略，实现快速且有效的生成有毒对抗样本。两种新的目标函数设计使 ToxicTrap 能够识别多类别和多标签毒性语言检测器中的弱点。我们的实验结果表明，最先进的毒性文本分类器确实对提出的攻击非常脆弱，在多标签情况下，攻击成功率超过98%。我们还展示了如何通过普通的对抗训练及其改进版本来提高毒性检测器的鲁棒性，即使面对未见过的攻击也是如此。

[No.1198] Transformer Language Models Handle Word Frequency in Prediction Head
来源: ACL 2023
命中: predict
标题: 变压器语言模型在预测头中处理词频

英摘: Prediction head is a crucial component of Transformer language models. Despite its direct impact on prediction, this component has often been overlooked in analyzing Transformers. 中摘: 预测头是Transformer语言模型中的关键组成部分。尽管它直接关系到预测效果，但在分析Transformer时，这一组件常常被忽视。在本研究中，我们调查了预测头的内部工作机制，特别是关注偏置参数的作用。我们的实验结果显示，BERT和GPT-2模型中的词预测头中的偏置在其反映语料库中词汇频率的能力上扮演了重要角色，这与长尾学习中常用的logit调整方法一致。我们还量化了在实际自回归文本生成场景中控制这些偏置的效果；在特定设置下，可以生成更加多样的文本而不牺牲文本质量。

[No.1199] Uncertainty-Aware Unlikelihood Learning Improves Generative Aspect Sentiment Quad Prediction
来源: ACL 2023
命中: predict
标题: 面向不确定性的不可likelihood学习改进生成方面情感四元预测
类别: 
作者: Mengting Hu;Yinhao Bai;Yike Wu;Zhen Zhang;Liqi Zhang;Hang Gao;Shiwan Zhao;Minlie Huang;
机构: Nankai University;Tiangong University;Tsinghua University;
类型: Findings
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2023.findings-acl.851/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2306.00418
英摘: Recently, aspect sentiment quad prediction has received widespread attention in the field of aspect-based sentiment analysis. Existing studies extract quadruplets via pre-trained generative language models to paraphrase the original sentence into a templated target sequence. However, previous works only focus on what to generate but ignore what not to generate. We argue that considering the negative samples also leads to potential benefits. In this work, we propose a template-agnostic method to control the token-level generation, which boosts original learning and reduces mistakes simultaneously. Specifically, we introduce Monte Carlo dropout to understand the built-in uncertainty of pre-trained language models, acquiring the noises and errors. We further propose marginalized unlikelihood learning to suppress the uncertainty-aware mistake tokens. Extensive experiments on four public datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on various generation templates.

英摘: Languages are dynamic entities, where the meanings associated with words constantly change with time. Detecting the semantic variation of words is an important task for various NLP applications that must make time-sensitive predictions. Existing work on semantic variation prediction have predominantly focused on comparing some form of an averaged contextualised representation of a target word computed from a given corpus. However, some of the previously associated meanings of a target word can become obsolete over time (e.g. meaning of gay as happy), while novel usages of existing words are observed (e.g. meaning of cell as a mobile phone). 来源: EMNLP 2024

In this context, we attempt to re-visit the scaling behavior of LLMs under the hood of CPT, and discover a power-law relationship between loss, mixture ratio, and training tokens scale. 标题: 大型语言模型协作性能预测
类别: 
作者: Qiyuan Zhang;Fuyuan Lyu;Xue Liu;Chen Ma;
机构: City University of Hong Kong;McGill University;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.150/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.01300
英摘: Comprehensively understanding and accurately predicting the performance of large language models across diverse downstream tasks has emerged as a pivotal challenge in NLP research. The pioneering scaling law on downstream works demonstrated intrinsic similarities within model families and utilized such similarities for performance prediction. However, they tend to overlook the similarities between model families and only consider design factors listed in the original scaling law. To overcome these limitations, we introduce a novel framework, Collaborative Performance Prediction (CPP), which significantly enhances prediction accuracy by leveraging the historical performance of various models on downstream tasks and other design factors for both model and task. We also collect a collaborative data sourced from online platforms containing both historical performance and additional design factors. With the support of the collaborative data, CPP not only surpasses traditional scaling laws in predicting the performance of scaled LLMs but also facilitates a detailed analysis of factor importance, an area previously overlooked.
中摘: 全面理解和准确预测大型语言模型在多种下游任务中的性能已成为NLP研究中的一个关键挑战。早期提出的下游工作扩展定律展示了模型家族内部固有的相似性，并利用这些相似性进行性能预测。然而，这些扩展定律往往忽视了不同模型家族之间的相似性，仅考虑原始扩展定律中列出的设计因素。为克服这些限制，我们引入了一种新的框架——协作性能预测（CPP），该框架通过利用各种模型在下游任务上的历史性能和其他模型和任务的设计因素，显著提高了预测准确性。我们还收集了一种协作数据源，该数据源来自在线平台，包含了历史性能和其他设计因素。借助这种协作数据的支持，CPP 不仅超越了传统的扩展定律，在预测缩放的大规模语言模型的性能方面表现更佳，还促进了对因素重要性的详细分析，这是之前被忽略的一个领域。

[No.1214] Consolidating Ranking and Relevance Predictions of Large Language Models through Post-Processing
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: predict
标题: 通过后处理整合大型语言模型的排名和相关性预测
类别: 
作者: Le Yan;Zhen Qin;Honglei Zhuang;Rolf Jagerman;Xuanhui Wang;Michael Bendersky;Harrie Oosterhuis;
机构: Google;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.25/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.11791
英摘: The powerful generative abilities of large language models (LLMs) show potential in generating relevance labels for search applications. Previous work has found that directly asking about relevancy, such as ``How relevant is document A to query Q?", results in sub-optimal ranking. Instead, the pairwise ranking prompting (PRP) approach produces promising ranking performance through asking about pairwise comparisons, e.g., ``Is document A more relevant than document B to query Q?". Thus, while LLMs are effective at their ranking ability, this is not reflected in their relevance label generation. In this work, we propose a post-processing method to consolidate the relevance labels generated by an LLM with its powerful ranking abilities. Our method takes both LLM generated relevance labels and pairwise preferences. The labels are then altered to satisfy the pairwise preferences of the LLM, while staying as close to the original values as possible. Our experimental results indicate that our approach effectively balances label accuracy and ranking performance. Thereby, our work shows it is possible to combine both the ranking and labeling abilities of LLMs through post-processing.
中摘: 大型语言模型（LLM）的强大生成能力在为搜索应用生成相关标签方面显示出潜力。以往的研究发现，直接询问相关性，例如“文档A与查询Q的相关性如何？”，会导致排名不佳。相反，通过询问两两比较的问题，如“文档A与文档B相比，哪一个更相关于查询Q？”来采用成对排名提示（PRP）方法可以产生令人鼓舞的排名性能。因此，尽管LLM在其排名能力方面非常有效，但这种效果并没有反映在其生成的相关标签上。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种后处理方法，以结合LLM生成的相关标签与其强大的排名能力。该方法同时考虑了LLM生成的相关标签和成对偏好。标签随后被调整以满足LLM的成对偏好，同时尽可能保持原始值的准确性。我们的实验结果表明，我们的方法有效地平衡了标签准确性和排名性能。因此，我们的工作展示了可以通过后处理将LLM的排名能力和标签能力结合起来的可能性。

英摘: We propose a multi-agent debate as optimization (DAO) system for event extraction, where the primary objective is to iteratively refine the large language models (LLMs) outputs through debating without parameter tuning. In DAO, we introduce two novel modules: the Diverse-RAG (DRAG) module and the Adaptive Conformal Prediction (AdaCP) module. DRAG systematically retrieves supporting information that best fits the debate discussion, while AdaCP enhances the accuracy and reliability of event extraction by effectively rejecting less promising answers. [No.1217] DKEC: Domain Knowledge Enhanced Multi-Label Classification for Diagnosis Prediction
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: predict
标题: DKEC：领域知识增强多标签分类在诊断预测中的应用
类别: 
作者: Xueren Ge;Abhishek Satpathy;Ronald Dean Williams;John Stankovic;Homa Alemzadeh;
机构: University of Virginia;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.712/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.07059
英摘: Multi-label text classification (MLTC) tasks in the medical domain often face the long-tail label distribution problem. Prior works have explored hierarchical label structures to find relevant information for few-shot classes, but mostly neglected to incorporate external knowledge from medical guidelines. This paper presents DKEC, Domain Knowledge Enhanced Classification for diagnosis prediction with two innovations: (1) automated construction of heterogeneous knowledge graphs from external sources to capture semantic relations among diverse medical entities, (2) incorporating the heterogeneous knowledge graphs in few-shot classification using a label-wise attention mechanism. We construct DKEC using three online medical knowledge sources and evaluate it on a real-world Emergency Medical Services (EMS) dataset and a public electronic health record (EHR) dataset. Results show that DKEC outperforms the state-of-the-art label-wise attention networks and transformer models of different sizes, particularly for the few-shot classes. More importantly, it helps the smaller language models achieve comparable performance to large language models.
中摘: 医疗领域的多标签文本分类任务（MLTC）经常面临长尾标签分布问题。先前的工作探索了层次标签结构以找到少量样本类别的相关信息，但大多忽略了从医学指南中整合外部知识。本文提出了DKEC（领域知识增强分类），这是一种用于诊断预测的创新分类方法，包含两大革新：（1）从外部来源自动生成异构知识图谱，以捕捉不同医疗实体之间的语义关系；（2）通过标签级注意力机制将异构知识图谱融入少量样本分类中。我们使用三个在线医学知识源构建了DKEC，并在实际的紧急医疗服务（EMS）数据集和一个公开的电子健康记录（EHR）数据集上进行了评估。结果显示，DKEC在标签级注意力网络以及不同大小的变压器模型中表现更优，特别是在少量样本类别方面。更重要的是，它帮助较小的语言模型达到了与大型语言模型相当的性能。

[No.1218] Enabling Discriminative Reasoning in LLMs for Legal Judgment Prediction
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: predict
标题: 在LLMs中启用区分性推理以预测法律判决
类别: 
作者: Chenlong Deng;Kelong Mao;Yuyao Zhang;Zhicheng Dou;

类型: finding

英摘: Legal judgment prediction is essential for enhancing judicial efficiency. In this work, we identify that existing large language models (LLMs) underperform in this domain due to challenges in understanding case complexities and distinguishing between similar charges. To adapt LLMs for effective legal judgment prediction, we introduce the Ask-Discriminate-Predict (ADAPT) reasoning framework inspired by human judicial reasoning. ADAPT involves decomposing case facts, discriminating among potential charges, and predicting the final judgment. [No.1219] Fine-Grained Prediction of Reading Comprehension from Eye Movements
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: predict
标题: 基于眼动的细粒度阅读理解预测
类别: 
作者: Omer Shubi;Yoav Meiri;Cfir Avraham Hadar;Yevgeni Berzak;
机构: Technion - Israel Institute of Technology;Massachusetts Institute of Technology;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.198/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.04484
英摘: Can human reading comprehension be assessed from eye movements in reading? In this work, we address this longstanding question using large-scale eyetracking data over textual materials that are geared towards behavioral analyses of reading comprehension. We focus on a fine-grained and largely unaddressed task of predicting reading comprehension from eye movements at the level of a single question over a passage. We tackle this task using three new multimodal language models, as well as a battery of prior models from the literature. We evaluate the models' ability to generalize to new textual items, new participants, and the combination of both, in two different reading regimes, ordinary reading and information seeking. The evaluations suggest that although the task is highly challenging, eye movements contain useful signals for fine-grained prediction of reading comprehension. Code and data will be made publicly available.
中摘: 人类的阅读理解能力能否通过阅读时的眼动来评估？在这项工作中，我们使用大规模的眼动追踪数据，针对旨在行为分析阅读理解的心理材料，探讨了这一长期存在的问题。我们专注于一个精细粒度且尚未充分解决的任务：在一段文本上预测单个问题的阅读理解能力，基于眼动数据。我们利用三种新的多模态语言模型以及文献中的一系列先前模型来应对这一任务。我们在两种不同的阅读模式——普通阅读和信息检索——下评估模型的一般化能力，即模型能否适应新的文本材料、新的参与者，或者同时适应新的文本材料和新的参与者。评估结果显示，尽管该任务极具挑战性，但眼动数据仍然包含有助于精细预测阅读理解的有用信号。代码和数据将公开发布。

[No.1220] Fine-Tuning Large Language Models for Stock Return Prediction Using Newsflow
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: predict
标题: 使用新闻流 Fine-Tuning 大型语言模型进行股票回报预测
类别: 
作者: Tian Guo;Emmanuel Hauptmann;
机构: RAM Active Investments;
类型: Industry
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-industry.77/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2407.18103
英摘: Large language models (LLMs) and their fine-tuning techniques have demonstrated superior performance in various language understanding and generation tasks. This paper explores fine-tuning LLMs for stock return forecasting with financial newsflow. In quantitative investing, return forecasting is fundamental for subsequent tasks like stock picking, portfolio optimization, etc. We formulate the model to include text representation and forecasting modules. We propose to compare the encoder-only and decoder-only LLMs, considering they generate text representations in distinct ways. The impact of these different representations on forecasting performance remains an open question. Meanwhile, we compare two simple methods of integrating LLMs' token-level representations into the forecasting module. The experiments on real news and investment universes reveal that: (1) aggregated representations from LLMs' token-level embeddings generally produce return predictions that enhance the performance of long-only and long-short portfolios; (2) in the relatively large investment universe, the decoder LLMs-based prediction model leads to stronger portfolios, whereas in the small universes, there are no consistent winners. Among the three LLMs studied (DeBERTa, Mistral, Llama), Mistral performs more robustly across different universes; (3) return predictions derived from LLMs' text representations are a strong signal for portfolio construction, outperforming conventional sentiment scores.
中摘: 大型语言模型（LLMs）及其微调技术在各种语言理解和生成任务中表现出卓越性能。本文探讨了使用金融新闻流对LLMs进行微调以进行股票回报预测的方法。在量化投资中，回报预测是后续任务如股票挑选、组合优化等的基础。我们构建了包含文本表示和预测模块的模型，并提出比较仅编码器和仅解码器的LLMs，因为它们以不同的方式生成文本表示。这些不同表示对预测性能的影响仍是一个开放的问题。同时，我们比较了将LLMs的标记级表示集成到预测模块中的两种简单方法。实验证实在真实新闻和投资领域中：（1）来自LLMs标记级嵌入的聚合表示通常能提高仅多头和多空组合的投资表现；（2）在相对较大的投资领域中，基于解码器LLMs的预测模型会产生更强的投资组合，而在较小的领域中，没有一致的赢家；（3）在研究的三种LLMs（DeBERTa、Mistral、Llama）中，Mistral在不同领域中表现得更为稳健；（4）从LLMs文本表示中得出的回报预测是投资组合构建的强大信号，优于传统的情绪分数。

[No.1222] Incorporating Precedents for Legal Judgement Prediction on European Court of Human Rights Cases
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: predict
标题: 欧洲人权法院案件的法律判决预测中的 precedents 融合
类别: 
作者: Santosh T.y.s.s;Mohamed Hesham Elganayni;Stanisław Sójka;Matthias Grabmair;
机构: 
类型: finding

英摘: Inspired by the legal doctrine of stare decisis, which leverages precedents (prior cases) for informed decision-making, we explore methods to integrate them into LJP models. To facilitate precedent retrieval, we train a retriever with a fine-grained relevance signal based on the overlap ratio of alleged articles between cases. We investigate two strategies to integrate precedents: direct incorporation at inference via label interpolation based on case proximity and during training via a precedent fusion module using a stacked-cross attention model. We employ joint training of the retriever and LJP models to address latent space divergence between them. Our experiments on LJP tasks from the ECHR jurisdiction reveal that integrating precedents during training coupled with joint training of the retriever and LJP model, outperforms models without precedents or with precedents incorporated only at inference, particularly benefiting sparser articles.

[No.1224] Language models and brains align due to more than next-word prediction and word-level information
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: predict
标题: 语言模型和大脑在预测下一个词和单词级信息之外还存在更多的相似之处
类别: 
作者: Gabriele Merlin;Mariya Toneva;
机构: Max Planck Institute for Software Systems;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.1024/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.00596
英摘: Pretrained language models have been shown to significantly predict brain recordings of people comprehending language. Recent work suggests that the prediction of the next word is a key mechanism that contributes to this alignment. What is not yet understood is whether prediction of the next word is necessary for this observed alignment or simply sufficient, and whether there are other shared mechanisms or information that are similarly important. In this work, we take a step towards understanding the reasons for brain alignment via two simple perturbations in popular pretrained language models. [No.1231] On the Role of Context in Reading Time Prediction
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: predict
标题: 阅读时间预测中的背景作用
类别: 
作者: Andreas Opedal;Eleanor Chodroff;Ryan Cotterell;Ethan Wilcox;
机构: ETH Zurich;Max Planck ETH Center for Learning Systems;University of Zurich;
类型: Main
链接: https://aclanthology.org/2024.emnlp-main.179/
arXi: https://arxiv.org/abs/2409.08160
英摘: We present a new perspective on how readers integrate context during real-time language comprehension. Our proposals build on surprisal theory, which posits that the processing effort of a linguistic unit (e.g., a word) is an affine function of its in-context information content. We first observe that surprisal is only one out of many potential ways that a contextual predictor can be derived from a language model. Another one is the pointwise mutual information (PMI) between a unit and its context, which turns out to yield the same predictive power as surprisal when controlling for unigram frequency. Moreover, both PMI and surprisal are correlated with frequency. This means that neither PMI nor surprisal contains information about context alone. In response to this, we propose a technique where we project surprisal onto the orthogonal complement of frequency, yielding a new contextual predictor that is uncorrelated with frequency. Our experiments show that the proportion of variance in reading times explained by context is a lot smaller when context is represented by the orthogonalized predictor. From an interpretability standpoint, this indicates that previous studies may have overstated the role that context has in predicting reading times.
中摘: 我们提供了一种新的视角，探讨读者在实时语言理解过程中如何整合上下文信息。我们的提议建立在意外理论的基础上，该理论认为一个语言单位（例如，一个词）的处理努力是一个上下文信息含量的线性函数。首先，我们观察到意外理论只是许多潜在的上下文预测方法之一，另一种方法是语言模型中的单元与其上下文之间的点互信息（PMI），当控制单次频率时，这种PMI实际上与意外理论具有相同的预测能力。此外，PMI和意外理论都与频率相关。这意味着PMI或意外理论本身并不包含仅关于上下文的信息。为应对这一问题，我们提出了一种技术，即将意外理论投影到频率的正交补空间上，从而得到一个新的与频率无关的上下文预测方法。我们的实验表明，当使用正交化后的预测方法表示上下文时，阅读时间变异性的解释比例要小得多。从可解释性的角度来看，这表明以往的研究可能高估了上下文在预测阅读时间中的作用。

英摘: Transformer-based large language models (LLMs) exhibit limitations such as generating unsafe responses, unreliable reasoning, etc. Existing inference intervention approaches attempt to mitigate these issues by finetuning additional models to produce calibration signals (such as rewards) that guide the LLM's decoding process. [No.1237] Private prediction for large-scale synthetic text generation
来源: EMNLP 2024
命中: predict
标题: 大规模合成文本生成的私人预测
类别: 
作者: Kareem Amin;Alex Bie;Weiwei Kong;Alexey Kurakin;Natalia Ponomareva;Umar Syed;Andreas Terzis;Sergei Vassilvitskii;

英摘: We present an approach for generating differentially private synthetic text using large language models (LLMs), via private prediction. In the private prediction framework, we only require the output synthetic data to satisfy differential privacy guarantees. This is in contrast to approaches that train a generative model on potentially sensitive user-supplied source data and seek to ensure the model itself is safe to release.
  We prompt a pretrained LLM with source data, but ensure that next-token predictions are made with differential privacy guarantees. Previous work in this paradigm reported generating a small number of examples (<10) at reasonable privacy levels, an amount of data that is useful only for downstream in-context learning or prompting. In contrast, we make changes that allow us to generate thousands of high-quality synthetic data points, greatly expanding the set of potential applications. Our improvements come from an improved privacy analysis and a better private selection mechanism, which makes use of the equivalence between the softmax layer for sampling tokens in LLMs and the exponential mechanism. Furthermore, we introduce a novel use of public predictions via the sparse vector technique, in which we do not pay privacy costs for tokens that are predictable without sensitive data; we find this to be particularly effective for structured data.

我们用预训练的LLM提供源数据，但确保下一步预测是在满足差分隐私保证的情况下进行的。在此范式下的先前工作报告称，生成的小数量示例（少于10个）在合理的隐私水平下完成，这些数据量仅适用于下游的上下文学习或提示。相比之下，我们进行了改进，使我们能够生成数千个高质量的合成数据点，极大地扩展了潜在的应用范围。我们的改进来自更先进的隐私分析和更好的私密选择机制，后者利用了LLMs中的softmax层与指数机制之间的等价性。此外，我们引入了一种新颖的公共预测使用方法，通过稀疏向量技术，在不需要为无需敏感数据即可预测的令牌支付隐私成本的情况下，发现这种方法特别适用于结构化数据。

英摘: We propose an end-to-end differentiable training paradigm for stable training of a rationalized transformer classifier. To this end, we build on the widely-used three-player-game for training rationalized models, which typically relies on training a rationale selector, a classifier and a complement classifier. We simplify this approach by making a single model fulfill all three roles, leading to a more efficient training paradigm that is not susceptible to the common training instabilities that plague existing approaches. Further, we extend this paradigm to produce class-wise rationales while incorporating recent advances in parameterizing and regularizing the resulting rationales, thus leading to substantially improved and state-of-the-art alignment with human annotations without any explicit supervision.
中摘: 我们提出了一种端到端可微训练范式，用于稳定训练理性的变压器分类器。我们的方法产生了一个单一模型，该模型同时对样本进行分类，并根据输入词项与分类的相关性对其进行评分。为此，我们基于广泛使用的三玩家游戏训练理性的模型方法，该方法通常依赖于训练一个理由选择器、一个分类器和一个互补分类器。通过使单一模型承担所有三个角色，我们简化了这一方法，从而形成一种更高效的训练范式，这种范式不受现有方法中常见的训练不稳定性的影响。此外，我们将这一范式扩展为生成类别的理由，同时整合了参数化和正则化这些理由的最新进展，因此在没有任何显式监督的情况下，显著提高了与人类标注的对齐度，并达到了最先进的水平。
